Question: 随着中国民族资本主义产生和发展，工商业者群体意识逐渐形成，作为一种新的社会力量，工商业者在创办实业、抵制洋货、收回利权、立宪运动、民主革命、抗日救亡等众多社会事务中日益显示出自身的实力和存在价值。对此，下列历史解释正确的是
A: 工商业者是倡导革命的新中坚力量
B: 工商业者依旧属于传统的社会群体
C: 工商业者投身社会事务是有利可图
D: 工商业者推动了近代中国社会发展
options:
A. 工商业者是倡导革命的新中坚力量
B. 工商业者依旧属于传统的社会群体
C. 工商业者投身社会事务是有利可图
D. 工商业者推动了近代中国社会发展
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
随着中国民族资本主义产生和发展，工商业者群体意识逐渐形成，作为一种新的社会力量，工商业者在创办实业、抵制洋货、收回利权、立宪运动、民主革命、抗日救亡等众多社会事务中日益显示出自身的实力和存在价值。对此，下列历史解释正确的是
A. 工商业者是倡导革命的新中坚力量
B. 工商业者依旧属于传统的社会群体
C. 工商业者投身社会事务是有利可图
D. 工商业者推动了近代中国社会发展
en:
The next question is about China's history.
With the emergence and development of Chinese national capitalism, the collective consciousness of industrialists and businessmen gradually formed. As a new social force, industrialists and businessmen increasingly demonstrated their strength and existence value in many social affairs such as establishing industries, boycotting foreign goods, recovering profit rights, constitutional movement, democratic revolution, and anti-Japanese and national salvation. In this regard, the following historical explanation is correct
A. Industrialists and businessmen are the new backbone force advocating revolution
B. Industrialists and businessmen still belong to traditional social groups
C. It is profitable for industrialists and businessmen to engage in social affairs
D. Industrialists and businessmen promoted the development of modern Chinese society

Question: 乾隆时江南地主“所居在城或他州异县，地亩山场皆委之佃户”。苏州甚至出现“土著安业者田不满百亩，余皆佃农也。上田半归于郡城之富户”。由此可知，当时江南
A: 个体农耕为主要生产形式
B: 农业中商品化生产普遍
C: 农业生产利润微不足道
D: 土地所有权变更极为频繁
options:
A. 个体农耕为主要生产形式
B. 农业中商品化生产普遍
C. 农业生产利润微不足道
D. 土地所有权变更极为频繁
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
乾隆时江南地主“所居在城或他州异县，地亩山场皆委之佃户”。苏州甚至出现“土著安业者田不满百亩，余皆佃农也。上田半归于郡城之富户”。由此可知，当时江南
A. 个体农耕为主要生产形式
B. 农业中商品化生产普遍
C. 农业生产利润微不足道
D. 土地所有权变更极为频繁
en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the Qianlong period, the landlords in Jiangnan "lived in the city or other states and counties, and all the land and fields were entrusted to tenants." In Suzhou, there was even a situation where "the natives who settled down had less than 100 acres of land, and the rest were tenants. Half of the land belonged to the rich families in the county town." From this, we can know that at that time in Jiangnan
A. individual farming was the main form of production
B. commercial production was common in agriculture
C. agricultural production profits were negligible
D. land ownership changes were extremely frequent

Question: 《新全球史》记载，从公元前6世纪开始，铁制农具在中国骤然增加，铁犁、铁镐、铁镰刀和铁耙在乡村里成为日常用具，这一现象给当时社会发展带来的影响不包括
A: “庶人食力，工商食官”
B: “除井田，民得买卖”
C: “宗庙之牺为畎亩之勤”
D: “秋七月，初税田”
options:
A. “庶人食力，工商食官”
B. “除井田，民得买卖”
C. “宗庙之牺为畎亩之勤”
D. “秋七月，初税田”
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《新全球史》记载，从公元前6世纪开始，铁制农具在中国骤然增加，铁犁、铁镐、铁镰刀和铁耙在乡村里成为日常用具，这一现象给当时社会发展带来的影响不包括

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The New Global History records that iron farm tools increased suddenly in China from the 6th century BC, and iron plows, iron pickaxes, iron sickles and iron rakes became daily tools in the countryside. The impact of this phenomenon on social development at that time did not include
A. "Common people eat by labor, and businessmen eat by officials"
B. "The well fields were abolished, and the people were able to trade"
C. "The sacrifices in the ancestral temples were for the hard work of the fields"
D. "In the seventh month of autumn, the land was taxed first"

Question: 据研究，1853年，印度人均消费英国棉纱、棉布9.09便士，而中国是0.94便士。这反映出当时中国
A: 经济受到鸦片战争的破坏
B: 实行保护本国经济的政策
C: 经济的发展水平低于印度
D: 传统的小农经济根深蒂固
options:
A. 经济受到鸦片战争的破坏
B. 实行保护本国经济的政策
C. 经济的发展水平低于印度
D. 传统的小农经济根深蒂固
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
据研究，1853年，印度人均消费英国棉纱、棉布9.09便士，而中国是0.94便士。这反映出当时中国
A. 经济受到鸦片战争的破坏
B. 实行保护本国经济的政策
C. 经济的发展水平低于印度
D. 传统的小农经济根深蒂固
en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to research, in 1853, the average Indian spent 9.09 pence per capita on British cotton yarn and cloth, while the average Chinese spent 0.94 pence. This reflects that at that time, China
A. had its economy damaged by the Opium War
B. had implemented a policy of protecting its own economy
C. had a lower level of economic development than India
D. had a deep-rooted traditional small-scale peasant economy

Question: 孔子曾提出过“君子和而不同”的思想，意思是“和谐而又不千篇一律，不同而又不互相冲突”，运用这种思想处理不同社会制度国家间关系取得成功的范例是
A: 日内瓦会议的圆满成功
B: 万隆会议的圆满成功
C: 签订《中苏友好同盟互助条约》
D: 香港、澳门回归
options:
A. 日内瓦会议的圆满成功
B. 万隆会议的圆满成功
C. 签订《中苏友好同盟互助条约》

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
孔子曾提出过“君子和而不同”的思想，意思是“和谐而又不千篇一律，不同而又不互相冲突”，运用这种思想处理不同社会制度国家间关系取得成功的范例是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Confucius once proposed the idea of "gentlemen are harmonious but different", which means "harmonious but not stereotyped, different but not conflicting". The successful example of using this idea to deal with relations between countries with different social systems is 
A. The complete success of the Geneva Conference
B. The complete success of the Bandung Conference
C. The signing of the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance
D. The return of Hong Kong and Macao

Question: 炎帝是我国传说时代的英雄，又称神农氏。据传他使用“焚林而田”的耕作方法，还发明了耒、耜等生产工具。这些传说
A: 可以作为中国原始农耕的直接证据
B: 证明了炎帝的真实存在
C: 是一种没有史料价值的想象
D: 折射出中国农耕文明源远流长
options:
A. 可以作为中国原始农耕的直接证据
B. 证明了炎帝的真实存在
C. 是一种没有史料价值的想象
D. 折射出中国农耕文明源远流长
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
炎帝是我国传说时代的英雄，又称神农氏。据传他使用“焚林而田”的耕作方法，还发明了耒、耜等生产工具。这些传说

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Yandi was a hero in the legendary era of my country, also known as Shennong. It is said that he used the farming method of "burning forests to make fields" and invented production tools such as plows and hoes. These legends
A. can be used as direct evidence of China's primitive farming
B. prove the real existence of Yandi
C. is an imagination with no historical value
D. reflects the long history of China's farming civilization

Question: 《齐民要术》自序：“盖神农为耒耜，以利天下，尧命四子，敬授民时，降命后稷，食为政首，……殷周之盛，《诗》《书》所述，要在安民，富而教之。”这段话主要强调
A: 农业技术和重要性
B: 历法与农业的关系
C: 儒家对农业的重视
D: 改进生产工具的意义
options:
A. 农业技术和重要性
B. 历法与农业的关系
C. 儒家对农业的重视
D. 改进生产工具的意义

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《齐民要术》自序：“盖神农为耒耜，以利天下，尧命四子，敬授民时，降命后稷，食为政首，……殷周之盛，《诗》《书》所述，要在安民，富而教之。”这段话主要强调

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The preface of "Qimin Yaoshu" reads: "It was Shennong who invented the plow and hoe to benefit the world. Yao ordered his four sons to teach the people the time and ordered Houji to make food the first priority of government... The prosperity of the Yin and Zhou dynasties, as described in "Book of Songs" and "Book of Documents", was to keep the people safe and educate them when they were rich." This passage mainly emphasizes
A. Agricultural technology and importance
B. The relationship between the calendar and agriculture
C. The importance of agriculture by Confucianism
D. The significance of improving production tools

Question: 明隆庆初年，“抚臣涂泽民用鉴前辙，为因势利导之举，请开市舶，易私贩而为公贩，易只通东西二洋，不得往日本倭国，亦禁不得以硝黄、铜、铁违禁之物夹带出海。奉旨允行，凡三十载，幸大盗不作，而海宇宴如”。这说明当时
A: 官府废止明初以来“海禁”
B: 巡抚掌握对外贸易决策权
C: 官方朝贡贸易体系已瓦解
D: 官府有条件地开放“海禁”
options:
A. 官府废止明初以来“海禁”
B. 巡抚掌握对外贸易决策权
C. 官方朝贡贸易体系已瓦解
D. 官府有条件地开放“海禁”
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
明隆庆初年，“抚臣涂泽民用鉴前辙，为因势利导之举，请开市舶，易私贩而为公贩，易只通东西二洋，不得往日本倭国，亦禁不得以硝黄、铜、铁违禁之物夹带出海。奉旨允行，凡三十载，幸大盗不作，而海宇宴如”。这说明当时
A. 官府废止明初以来“海禁”
B. 巡抚掌握对外贸易决策权
C. 官方朝贡贸易体系已瓦解
D. 官府有条件地开放“海禁”
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early years of the Longqing reign of the Ming Dynasty, "the governor Tu Zemin, learning from the past, took the opportunity to open the maritime trade, changed private trade to public trade, and changed it to only trade in the East and West Oceans, not to Japan, and also prohibited the smuggling of prohibited items such as saltpeter, copper, and iron out of the sea. The order was granted, and for 30 years, there were no major thieves, and the world was at peace." This shows that at that time
A. The government abolished the "sea ban" since the early Ming Dynasty
B. The governor had the power to make decisions on foreign trade
C. The official tribute trade system had collapsed
D. The government conditionally opened the "sea ban"

Question: 长征期间，国内外形势发生重大变化，民族矛盾加剧，中国共产党的方针政策进行重大调整。这一调整是指
A: 召开八七会议，确定武装反抗国民党反动派的总方针
B: 召开七大，确立毛泽东思想的指导地位
C: 发表“八一宣言”，号召停止内战，一致抗日
D: 召开遵义会议，纠正“左”倾错误路线
options:
A. 召开八七会议，确定武装反抗国民党反动派的总方针
B. 召开七大，确立毛泽东思想的指导地位
C. 发表“八一宣言”，号召停止内战，一致抗日
D. 召开遵义会议，纠正“左”倾错误路线

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
长征期间，国内外形势发生重大变化，民族矛盾加剧，中国共产党的方针政策进行重大调整。这一调整是指

B. 召开七大，确立毛泽东思想的指导地位

D. 召开遵义会议，纠正“左”倾错误路线
en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the Long March, the domestic and international situation underwent major changes, ethnic conflicts intensified, and the CPC's policies and guidelines were significantly adjusted. This adjustment refers to
A. The August 7th Conference was held to determine the general policy of armed resistance against the Kuomintang reactionaries
B. The Seventh National Congress was held to establish the guiding position of Mao Zedong Thought
C. The "August 1st Declaration" was issued, calling for an end to the civil war and a united resistance against Japan
D. The Zunyi Conference was held to correct the "left" erroneous line

Question: 《周礼·考工记》载：建造王城，九里见方，四周各三门，南北和东西大道各九条，宫城之左为宗庙，右为社稷，前为朝，后为市。它体现的主要思想是
A: 中正有序
B: 中央集权
C: 敬天法祖
D: 君权神授
options:
A. 中正有序
B. 中央集权
C. 敬天法祖

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《周礼·考工记》载：建造王城，九里见方，四周各三门，南北和东西大道各九条，宫城之左为宗庙，右为社稷，前为朝，后为市。它体现的主要思想是
A. 中正有序
B. 中央集权
C. 敬天法祖

en:
The next question is about China's history.
"Zhou Li·Kaogongji" records: The construction of the royal city is nine li square, with three gates on each side, nine north-south and east-west roads, the left side of the palace is the ancestral temple, the right side is the altar, the front is the court, and the back is the market. The main ideas it embodies are
A. Justice and order
B. Centralization of power
C. Respecting heaven and following ancestors
D. The king's power is granted by God

Question: 在中国古代，褒扬官员德行和政绩，往往称其人为“民之父母”，官员亦以“为民父母”“爱民如子”作为执政的理想境界。这一现象反映出
A: 官员考核主要依据民本思想
B: “家天下”观念的政治影响
C: 官民之间具有共同政治诉求
D: 宗族关系已成为执政的基础
options:
A. 官员考核主要依据民本思想
B. “家天下”观念的政治影响
C. 官民之间具有共同政治诉求
D. 宗族关系已成为执政的基础
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
在中国古代，褒扬官员德行和政绩，往往称其人为“民之父母”，官员亦以“为民父母”“爱民如子”作为执政的理想境界。这一现象反映出
A. 官员考核主要依据民本思想
B. “家天下”观念的政治影响
C. 官民之间具有共同政治诉求

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In ancient China, officials were often praised for their virtues and achievements, and they were often called "the parents of the people". Officials also regarded "being the parents of the people" and "loving the people like their own children" as the ideal state of governing. This phenomenon reflects
A. Official assessment is mainly based on the people-oriented thought
B. The political influence of the concept of "family rule"
C. Officials and the people have common political demands
D. Clan relations have become the basis of governing

Question: 李鸿章在《示文儿》一信中说：“年来国事日非……受人凌辱之原因，莫外乎不谙世事，默守陈法，藏身于文字之间，而卑视工商。岂知世界文明，工商业较重于文字，窥各国之强盛，无独不然。”对材料理解正确的是
A: “受人凌辱”指的是中国甲午战败
B: 体现了挽救民族危机的愿望
C: 洋务运动抵制了西方的侵略
D: 作者认识到发展工商业的重要性
options:
A. “受人凌辱”指的是中国甲午战败
B. 体现了挽救民族危机的愿望
C. 洋务运动抵制了西方的侵略
D. 作者认识到发展工商业的重要性
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
李鸿章在《示文儿》一信中说：“年来国事日非……受人凌辱之原因，莫外乎不谙世事，默守陈法，藏身于文字之间，而卑视工商。岂知世界文明，工商业较重于文字，窥各国之强盛，无独不然。”对材料理解正确的是
A. “受人凌辱”指的是中国甲午战败
B. 体现了挽救民族危机的愿望
C. 洋务运动抵制了西方的侵略
D. 作者认识到发展工商业的重要性
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Li Hongzhang said in a letter to Wen'er: "In recent years, the national affairs have been getting worse and worse... The reason for being humiliated by others is nothing more than being ignorant of worldly affairs, silently following old laws, hiding in words, and despising industry and commerce. But in world civilization, industry and commerce are more important than words. Looking at the strength of various countries, it is not the same." The correct understanding of the material is
A. "Being humiliated by others" refers to China's defeat in the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895
B. It reflects the desire to save the national crisis
C. The Westernization Movement resisted Western aggression
D. The author realized the importance of developing industry and commerce

Question: 《太平寰宇记》记载当时全国户数：秦岭、淮河以南的户数占全国的59.1%，以北为40.9%。10万户以上的州和府，北方有2处，南方有3处；5万户到10万户的州，北方有5处，南方有17处。南多北少的户口分布格局至此定型。据此判断，《太平寰宇记》成书于
A: 宋代
B: 汉代
C: 秦代
D: 隋代
options:
A. 宋代
B. 汉代
C. 秦代
D. 隋代
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《太平寰宇记》记载当时全国户数：秦岭、淮河以南的户数占全国的59.1%，以北为40.9%。10万户以上的州和府，北方有2处，南方有3处；5万户到10万户的州，北方有5处，南方有17处。南多北少的户口分布格局至此定型。据此判断，《太平寰宇记》成书于
A. 宋代
B. 汉代
C. 秦代
D. 隋代
en:
The next question is about China's history.
The Taiping Huanyuji records the number of households in the country at that time: the number of households south of the Qinling Mountains and the Huai River accounted for 59.1% of the country, and the number of households north of the Qinling Mountains accounted for 40.9%. There were 2 states and prefectures with more than 100,000 households in the north and 3 in the south; there were 5 states with 50,000 to 100,000 households in the north and 17 in the south. The household distribution pattern of more in the south and less in the north was thus finalized. Based on this, it can be judged that the Taiping Huanyuji was written in
A. Song Dynasty
B. Han Dynasty
C. Qin Dynasty
D. Sui Dynasty

Question: 从1876年中英协商《烟台条约》的具体条款开始，英国就要求重庆立即对外通商，力图打开中国西部腹地的市场。中方谈判首脑李鸿章转弯抹角地回应：“轮船未抵重庆以前，英国商民不得在彼居住，开设行栈。”李鸿章此话的主要意图是
A: 借助英国开发西部市场
B: 利用英国开通川江航运
C: 变相地接受英国商民到重庆居住通商
D: 以轮船通航为条件拖延重庆对外通商
options:
A. 借助英国开发西部市场
B. 利用英国开通川江航运
C. 变相地接受英国商民到重庆居住通商
D. 以轮船通航为条件拖延重庆对外通商

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
从1876年中英协商《烟台条约》的具体条款开始，英国就要求重庆立即对外通商，力图打开中国西部腹地的市场。中方谈判首脑李鸿章转弯抹角地回应：“轮船未抵重庆以前，英国商民不得在彼居住，开设行栈。”李鸿章此话的主要意图是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Since the Sino-British negotiation of the specific terms of the Yantai Treaty in 1876, Britain has demanded that Chongqing immediately open to foreign trade, trying to open up the market in the hinterland of western China. Li Hongzhang, the head of the Chinese negotiations, responded in a roundabout way: "Before the ship arrives in Chongqing, British merchants and civilians are not allowed to live there or open warehouses." The main intention of Li Hongzhang's words was
A. to use Britain to develop the western market
B. to use Britain to open up the Sichuan-Yangtze River shipping
C. to accept British merchants and civilians to live and trade in Chongqing in disguise
D. to delay Chongqing's foreign trade on the condition of ship navigation

Question: 1959年5月15日，陈云在写给毛泽东的信中提到教训时说：“……把生产数字定得少一点（实际是可靠数字），会泄气，我看也不见得。正如少奇同志在政治局讲的，定高了，做不到，反而会泄气。”据此，你认为上面的应该是
A: 共产风
B: 浮夸风
C: 高速度
D: 高指标
options:
A. 共产风
B. 浮夸风

en:
The next question is about China's history.
On May 15, 1959, Chen Yun mentioned the lesson in a letter to Mao Zedong: "... I don't think it will be discouraging to set a lower production figure (actually a reliable figure). As Comrade Shaoqi said in the Politburo, setting a high figure and failing to achieve it will be discouraging." Based on this, what do you think should be the above?
A. Communism
B. Exaggeration
C. High speed
D. High target

Question: 1919年11月，全国各界联合会在上海成立，发表宣言：“数月以来，国内之群众运动，风起云涌，虽受种种压迫，而前仆后继，不少顾却；大义当前，绝不退让……全国各地，知合群自救为万不可缓之图。”这说明，当时参加联合会的各界团体
A: 对社会改造道路认识趋于一致
B: 反思资产阶级个人主义的弊端
C: 接受了马克思主义
D: 爱国觉悟得到提高
options:
A. 对社会改造道路认识趋于一致
B. 反思资产阶级个人主义的弊端

D. 爱国觉悟得到提高

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In November 1919, the National Federation of All Circles was established in Shanghai and issued a declaration: "For several months, the mass movement in the country has been surging. Although it has been oppressed in various ways, it has continued to fight and not given up. In the face of justice, we will never give in... All parts of the country know that it is imperative to unite and save ourselves." This shows that the groups from all walks of life who participated in the Federation at that time
A. had a consistent understanding of the path of social transformation
B. reflected on the shortcomings of bourgeois individualism
C. accepted Marxism
D. had a higher patriotic consciousness

Question: 晚清时期清政府实行专利制度，允许企业享有长时间生产经营垄断权。1912年北京政府规定专利保护期限最高为5年。后财政总长周学熙等为其所设公司申请30年的专利权时，未获批准。这反映了民国初期
A: 中央政府限制官营商业的发展
B: 建立了系统完善的经济法制体系
C: 经济法规得以完全遵照执行
D: 经济立法鼓励工商业自由竞争
options:
A. 中央政府限制官营商业的发展
B. 建立了系统完善的经济法制体系
C. 经济法规得以完全遵照执行
D. 经济立法鼓励工商业自由竞争
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
晚清时期清政府实行专利制度，允许企业享有长时间生产经营垄断权。1912年北京政府规定专利保护期限最高为5年。后财政总长周学熙等为其所设公司申请30年的专利权时，未获批准。这反映了民国初期
A. 中央政府限制官营商业的发展
B. 建立了系统完善的经济法制体系

D. 经济立法鼓励工商业自由竞争
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the late Qing Dynasty, the Qing government implemented a patent system, allowing enterprises to enjoy long-term production and operation monopoly rights. In 1912, the Beijing government stipulated that the maximum patent protection period was 5 years. Later, when Finance Minister Zhou Xuexi and others applied for a 30-year patent for their company, they were not approved. This reflects the early Republic of China
A. The central government restricted the development of state-owned commerce
B. A systematic and complete economic legal system was established
C. Economic laws and regulations were fully implemented
D. Economic legislation encouraged free competition in industry and commerce

Question: 清代有女诗人作诗曰：“人生德与才，兼备方为普。独至评闺材，持论恒相反。有德才可骇俗(兼有)，有才德反损……我意颇不然，此论殊褊浅。”这反映了在清代女性中
A: 德才兼备成为主要的评价标准
B: 产生了维护自身权益的诉求
C: 男女平等思想被普遍接受

options:

清代有女诗人作诗曰：“人生德与才，兼备方为普。独至评闺材，持论恒相反。有德才可骇俗(兼有)，有才德反损……我意颇不然，此论殊褊浅。”这反映了在清代女性中

en:
The next question is about China's history.
A female poet in the Qing Dynasty wrote a poem: "Only when people evaluate women's talents, their opinions are always opposite. Virtue and talent can shock the world (both), but talent and virtue are detrimental... I don't think so. This argument is narrow-minded." This reflects that among women in the Qing Dynasty
A. Virtue and talent became the main evaluation criteria
B. There was a demand to protect their own rights and interests
C. The idea of gender equality was generally accepted
D. There was a reflection on traditional ethical ideas

A: 北魏孝文帝改革

The next question is about China's history.

Question: 朱熹在《漳州劝农文》中说：“请诸父老，常为解说，使后生弟子，知所遵守，去恶从善，取是舍非，爱惜体肤，保守家业”。在此，朱熹
A: 告诫乡亲去恶从善以“慎思明辨”
B: 劝导百姓遵循一种“理性”的生活秩序
C: 灌输以农兴业思想以存“天理”
D: 教诲后生弟子遵从“三纲五常”
options:
A. 告诫乡亲去恶从善以“慎思明辨”
B. 劝导百姓遵循一种“理性”的生活秩序
C. 灌输以农兴业思想以存“天理”
D. 教诲后生弟子遵从“三纲五常”
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
朱熹在《漳州劝农文》中说：“请诸父老，常为解说，使后生弟子，知所遵守，去恶从善，取是舍非，爱惜体肤，保守家业”。在此，朱熹

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Zhu Xi said in "Zhangzhou Encouragement to Farmers" that "I ask all elders to explain it frequently so that the younger generation of students will know what to follow, abandon evil and follow good, choose right and discard wrong, cherish their bodies, and preserve their family business." Here, Zhu Xi
A. admonished fellow villagers to abandon evil and follow good in order to "think carefully and discern clearly"
B. persuaded the people to follow a "rational" life order
C. instilled the idea of developing agriculture to preserve "heavenly principles"
D. taught the younger generation of students to follow the "Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues"

Question: “民本”语出《尚书·夏书·五子之歌》：“民惟邦本，本固邦宁。”意谓人民是国家的根本，根本巩固，国家才能安宁。“民主”一词，最早见于古希腊历史学家希罗多德的《历史》一书，它由“人民”和“权利”两个词组合而成，其字面意思就是“人民的权利”、“人民主权”和“多数人的统治”。下列关于“民本”与“民主”的表述，正确的是
A: 两者都鼓励百姓为实现自己的追求而奋斗
B: 两者都具有限制和约束统治者行为的作用
C: 两者的区别在于“民”是否是国家的基础
D: 两者都利于从根本上改变百姓的社会地位
options:
A. 两者都鼓励百姓为实现自己的追求而奋斗
B. 两者都具有限制和约束统治者行为的作用
C. 两者的区别在于“民”是否是国家的基础
D. 两者都利于从根本上改变百姓的社会地位
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
“民本”语出《尚书·夏书·五子之歌》：“民惟邦本，本固邦宁。”意谓人民是国家的根本，根本巩固，国家才能安宁。“民主”一词，最早见于古希腊历史学家希罗多德的《历史》一书，它由“人民”和“权利”两个词组合而成，其字面意思就是“人民的权利”、“人民主权”和“多数人的统治”。下列关于“民本”与“民主”的表述，正确的是

C. 两者的区别在于“民”是否是国家的基础
D. 两者都利于从根本上改变百姓的社会地位
en:
The next question is about China's history.
The phrase "people-oriented" comes from "Book of History·Book of Xia·Song of the Five Sons": "People are the foundation of the country, and the country will be peaceful if the foundation is solid." It means that the people are the foundation of the country, and the country can be peaceful only if the foundation is solid. The word "democracy" was first seen in the book "History" by the ancient Greek historian Herodotus. It is composed of the two words "people" and "rights", and its literal meaning is "people's rights", "people's sovereignty" and "rule by the majority". The following statements about "people-oriented" and "democracy" are correct
A. Both encourage people to strive to achieve their own pursuits
B. Both have the function of limiting and restraining the behavior of rulers
C. The difference between the two lies in whether "people" is the foundation of the country
D. Both are conducive to fundamentally changing the social status of the people

Question: 《论语·八佾》记录孔子的话：“周监于二代，郁郁乎文哉！吾从周。”《荀子》说：“由士以上则必以礼节之。”对以上材料理解准确的是：a“周监于二代”中的“二代”是指夏商两代；b“吾从周”指孔子尊崇周礼；c夏商政治文化已成熟；d《荀子》指出了礼乐制在维护分封制、宗法制方面的重大作用
A: abc
B: abd
C: bcd
D: acd
options:
A. abc
B. abd
C. bcd
D. acd
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《论语·八佾》记录孔子的话：“周监于二代，郁郁乎文哉！吾从周。”《荀子》说：“由士以上则必以礼节之。”对以上材料理解准确的是：a“周监于二代”中的“二代”是指夏商两代；b“吾从周”指孔子尊崇周礼；c夏商政治文化已成熟；d《荀子》指出了礼乐制在维护分封制、宗法制方面的重大作用
A. abc
B. abd
C. bcd
D. acd
en:
The next question is about China's history.
The Analects of Confucius recorded Confucius' words: "Zhou learned from the two previous dynasties, how rich in culture! I follow Zhou." Xunzi said: "From the scholar level up, it is necessary to govern by etiquette." The correct understanding of the above materials is: a "Zhou learned from the two previous dynasties" refers to the Xia and Shang dynasties; b "I follow Zhou" refers to Confucius' respect for Zhou rituals; c Xia and Shang political culture has matured; d "Xunzi" pointed out the important role of ritual and music system in maintaining the feudal system and patriarchal system
A. abc
B. abd
C. bcd
D. acd

Question: 有学者说，在中国古代的政治制度建设中，古人为我们留下了诸多的治国智慧和法则，但也留下了许多的无奈。它最大的局限在于是一个统治性政权，不是一个发展性政权，更不是一个为国民共享的服务性政权。可见中国古代所有制度设计都围绕的一个核心是
A: 维护以“家天下”为核心的王权
B: 维护儒家思想的正统地位
C: 维护统一多民族国家主权
D: 维护专制主义的中央集权制度
options:
A. 维护以“家天下”为核心的王权
B. 维护儒家思想的正统地位
C. 维护统一多民族国家主权
D. 维护专制主义的中央集权制度
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
有学者说，在中国古代的政治制度建设中，古人为我们留下了诸多的治国智慧和法则，但也留下了许多的无奈。它最大的局限在于是一个统治性政权，不是一个发展性政权，更不是一个为国民共享的服务性政权。可见中国古代所有制度设计都围绕的一个核心是
A. 维护以“家天下”为核心的王权
B. 维护儒家思想的正统地位
C. 维护统一多民族国家主权
D. 维护专制主义的中央集权制度
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Some scholars say that in the construction of the political system in ancient China, the ancients left us many wisdoms and rules for governing the country, but also left us many frustrations. Its biggest limitation is that it is a ruling regime, not a developmental regime, and even less a service regime shared by the people. It can be seen that the core of all the institutional designs in ancient China is 
A. Maintaining the royal power with "family rule" as the core
B. Maintaining the orthodox status of Confucianism
C. Maintaining the sovereignty of a unified multi-ethnic country
D. Maintaining the centralized system of autocracy

Question: 明洪武二十八年规定，凡洪武二十七年以后新垦的田地，“不论多寡，俱不起科”，“若有司增科扰害者罪之”。这些措施
A: 可以促进农产品的商品化
B: 能鼓励垦荒
C: 降低赋税，减轻农民负担
D: 能有效抑制土地兼并
options:
A. 可以促进农产品的商品化
B. 能鼓励垦荒
C. 降低赋税，减轻农民负担
D. 能有效抑制土地兼并
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
明洪武二十八年规定，凡洪武二十七年以后新垦的田地，“不论多寡，俱不起科”，“若有司增科扰害者罪之”。这些措施
A. 可以促进农产品的商品化

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the 28th year of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty, it was stipulated that all newly reclaimed land after the 27th year of Hongwu, "regardless of the amount, will not be taxed" and "any official who increases taxes or disturbs others will be punished." These measures
A. can promote the commercialization of agricultural products
B. can encourage land reclamation
C. reduce taxes and reduce the burden on farmers
D. can effectively curb land annexation

Question: 明初废行省，地方分设三司，分别掌管一地民政与财政、司法、军事，直属六部。明中叶以后，皇帝临时派遣的巡抚逐渐演变为三司之上的地方最高行政长官。这一变化有助于
A: 提高地方行政效率
B: 缓解中央与地方的对立
C: 削弱六部的权限
D: 扩大地方行政权力
options:
A. 提高地方行政效率
B. 缓解中央与地方的对立
C. 削弱六部的权限
D. 扩大地方行政权力
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
明初废行省，地方分设三司，分别掌管一地民政与财政、司法、军事，直属六部。明中叶以后，皇帝临时派遣的巡抚逐渐演变为三司之上的地方最高行政长官。这一变化有助于
A. 提高地方行政效率
B. 缓解中央与地方的对立
C. 削弱六部的权限
D. 扩大地方行政权力
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early Ming Dynasty, the provinces were abolished and the local governments were divided into three departments, which were in charge of civil affairs and finance, justice, and military affairs of a place, and were directly under the six ministries. After the middle of the Ming Dynasty, the governors temporarily sent by the emperor gradually evolved into the highest local administrative officials above the three departments. This change helped
A. improve local administrative efficiency
B. ease the confrontation between the central government and local governments
C. weaken the authority of the six ministries
D. expand local administrative power

Question: 唐宣宗时，韦宙出任永州刺史，见当地俚民之俗：俚民婚，出财会宾客，号“破酒”，昼夜集，多至数百人，贫者犹数十；力不足，则不迎（娶），至私奔者。韦宙出示约束，使略如（汉）礼，俗遂改。可见，韦宙
A: 反对俚民举办婚宴
B: 提倡婚俗完全汉化
C: 反对婚礼大肆操办
D: 认可俚民不迎私奔
options:
A. 反对俚民举办婚宴
B. 提倡婚俗完全汉化

en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the reign of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Wei Zhou was appointed governor of Yongzhou. He saw the customs of the local people: when the local people got married, they would spend money to entertain guests, which was called "breaking wine". They would gather day and night, with as many as hundreds of people, and the poor would only have dozens. If they were not able to afford it, they would not marry, and some would elope. Wei Zhou issued a restriction to make it more similar to the (Han) etiquette, and the custom changed. It can be seen that Wei Zhou
A. opposed the holding of wedding banquets by the local people
B. advocated the complete sinicization of wedding customs
C. opposed the extravagant wedding
D. recognized that the local people would not marry and elope

Question: 近年来，随着文化市场的繁荣，各种穿越剧、抗日神剧和历史偶像剧轮番上演，一些影视作品中的雷人情节严重干扰了广大观众的正确历史观的形成，请从历史的角度看看，下面哪些影视剧中的场景是不可能发生的：a女主角欢天喜地的向康熙皇帝展示自己的无袖旗袍；b 中共地下党员在地铁站里向同伴传递日军情报；c一对年轻人身穿列宁装和布拉吉(连衣裙)，唱着欢快的苏联歌曲去剧院看“样板戏”；d 一位刚来深圳打工的年轻人从广播里得知恢复高考的消息毅然辞掉工作回家复习，准备圆自己的大学梦

In recent years, with the prosperity of the cultural market, various time-travel dramas, anti-Japanese dramas and historical idol dramas have been staged one after another. The outrageous plots in some film and television works have seriously interfered with the formation of the correct historical view of the general audience. Please look at the following scenes in film and television dramas from a historical perspective. It is impossible to happen: a. The heroine happily shows her sleeveless cheongsam to Emperor Kangxi; b. The underground members of the Communist Party of China pass on Japanese military intelligence to their companions in the subway station; c. A pair of young people wearing Lenin suits and bragi (dresses), singing cheerful Soviet songs to the theater to watch "model operas"; d. Question: 抗战爆发后，国民党内一部分人认为“中国武器不如人，战必败，再战必亡”；还有一部分人寄希望于外部干涉，认为“只要坚持打三个月，国际局势一定会发生变化”。在中国共产党内，也有少数人对战争的长期性和艰苦性缺乏准确判断和精神准备。为此，毛泽东发表了
A: 《论持久战》
B: 《论联合政府》
C: 《对日寇的最后一战》
D: 《关于正确处理人民内部矛盾的问题》

A. 《论持久战》
B. 《论联合政府》

The next question is about China's history.
After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War, some people in the Kuomintang believed that "China's weapons are inferior to others, and it will lose the war and perish if it fights again"; some people put their hopes on external interference, believing that "as long as we persist in fighting for three months, the international situation will definitely change." There are also a few people in the Communist Party of China who lack accurate judgment and mental preparation for the long-term and arduous nature of the war. For this reason, Mao Zedong published
A. "On Protracted War"
B. "On the United Government"
C. "The Last Battle against the Japanese Invaders"
D. "On the Correct Handling of Contradictions Among the People"

Question: 十月革命后，孙中山一面强调“以俄为师”，一面强调“不可学俄人之焦头烂额也”。据此可知孙中山主张

After the October Revolution, Sun Yat-sen emphasized "learning from Russia" and "not learning from the Russians' frustrations". Based on this, we can know that Sun Yat-sen advocated
A. Learn from the representative system and abandon the party-state system
B. Develop private capital and prevent state capital monopoly
C. Promote land revolution and realize "land to the tiller"
D. Learn from the revolutionary spirit of the Soviet Union and do not adopt the Soviet system

This reflects that the basic policy of the Qing Dynasty in governing the border areas was 
A. Military control

D. Expanding trade

Question: 1895年，一位中国外交官对当时四个欧美国家的政体分别作了如下评述，其中对德国的评述是

Question: 研究表明，明代大商人的资本一般为白银数十万两，多者上百万两。到清代中期，大商人的资本一般在一百万两以上，甚至多达千万两。这表明清代中期
A: 白银开始成为流通货币
B: 商业活动的规模进一步扩大
C: 重农抑商政策明显松弛
D: 商人的地位发生根本性改变
options:
A. 白银开始成为流通货币

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Research shows that the capital of big merchants in the Ming Dynasty was generally hundreds of thousands of taels of silver, and some even had millions of taels. By the middle of the Qing Dynasty, the capital of big merchants was generally more than one million taels, and even as much as 10 million taels. This shows that in the middle of the Qing Dynasty
A. Silver began to become a circulating currency
B. The scale of commercial activities further expanded
C. The policy of emphasizing agriculture and suppressing commerce was significantly relaxed
D. The status of merchants changed fundamentally

Question: “如果基督教国家参与镇压这场运动将是很悲哀的，因为起义者们抱着一种争取进步的激情和作全面改革的意向……目前显得较可取的惟一政策……避免与内战双方发生任何政府层面的瓜葛。”这则材料反映出
A: 北伐战争时期英国奉行中立政策

C: 辛亥革命时期英国采用外交孤立政策
D: 太平天国运动初期英国采取中立政策
options:
A. 北伐战争时期英国奉行中立政策
B. 义和团运动兴起后英国避免介入

The next question is about China's history.
"It would be tragic if Christian countries participated in suppressing this movement, because the rebels were motivated by a passion for progress and a desire for comprehensive reform... The only policy that seems more desirable at the moment is... to avoid any government involvement with either side of the civil war." This material reflects
A. Britain pursued a policy of neutrality during the Northern Expedition
B. Britain avoided intervention after the Boxer Rebellion
C. Britain adopted a policy of diplomatic isolation during the Xinhai Revolution
D. Britain adopted a policy of neutrality in the early days of the Taiping Rebellion

Question: 在今新疆和甘肃地区保存的佛教早期造像很多衣衫单薄，甚至裸身，面部表情生动；时代较晚的洛阳龙门石窟中，造像大都表情庄严，服饰亦趋整齐。引起这一变化的主要因素是
A: 经济发展水平
B: 绘画技术进步
C: 儒家思想影响
D: 政治权力干预
options:
A. 经济发展水平
B. 绘画技术进步
C. 儒家思想影响
D. 政治权力干预
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
在今新疆和甘肃地区保存的佛教早期造像很多衣衫单薄，甚至裸身，面部表情生动；时代较晚的洛阳龙门石窟中，造像大都表情庄严，服饰亦趋整齐。引起这一变化的主要因素是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Many of the early Buddhist statues preserved in Xinjiang and Gansu are thinly clothed, even naked, with vivid facial expressions; in the later Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, most of the statues have solemn expressions and neat clothing. The main factors causing this change are 
A. Economic development level 
B. Advances in painting technology 
C. Influence of Confucianism 
D. Political power intervention

Question: 自1962年世界上第一个机器人研制成功至今。机器人的发展经历丁三代。印操纵型机器人、自动型机器人和智能型机器人。机器人的使用
A: 推动了经济全球化进程
B: 体现了科学技术的综合运用
C: 促进了经济持续繁荣
D: 缓解了人口压力
options:

自1962年世界上第一个机器人研制成功至今。机器人的发展经历丁三代。印操纵型机器人、自动型机器人和智能型机器人。机器人的使用

The next question is about China's history.
Since the first robot was successfully developed in 1962, the development of robots has gone through three generations. There are three types of robots: manipulative robots, automatic robots and intelligent robots. The use of robots
A. Promoted the process of economic globalization
B. Reflected the comprehensive application of science and technology
C. Promoted sustained economic prosperity
D. Relieved population pressure

Question: 1952年我国高校进行院系调整，如调整后的天津大学下设土木建筑、电信、机械等7个工科系、20个专业和13个专修科，从综合大学转变为多科性工业大学。这种调整主要是为了
A: 推动天津经济建设发展
B: 促进国民经济的恢复
C: 培养经济建设专门人才
D: 提升国民的科技素养
options:

B. 促进国民经济的恢复

zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1952年我国高校进行院系调整，如调整后的天津大学下设土木建筑、电信、机械等7个工科系、20个专业和13个专修科，从综合大学转变为多科性工业大学。这种调整主要是为了

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1952, my country's colleges and universities adjusted their departments. For example, after the adjustment, Tianjin University had 7 engineering departments, including civil engineering, telecommunications, and machinery, 20 majors, and 13 specialized courses, transforming from a comprehensive university to a multidisciplinary industrial university. This adjustment was mainly to
A. Promote the development of Tianjin's economic construction
B. Promote the recovery of the national economy
C. Cultivate specialized talents for economic construction
D. Improve the scientific and technological literacy of the people

Question: 1921年中共“一大”上通过的《中国共产党纲领》（英文译稿）中规定：“以无产阶级革命军队推翻资产阶级，由劳动阶级重建国家，直至消灭阶级差别；……废除资本私有制，没收一切生产资料，如机器、土地、厂房、半成品等，归社会所有。”对上述材料的解读，不正确的是
A: 中共缺乏对中国国情的正确认识
B: 中共以反帝反封建为主要任务
C: 党纲通过宣告中国共产党的诞生
D: 中国共产党是新型的革命政党
options:
A. 中共缺乏对中国国情的正确认识
B. 中共以反帝反封建为主要任务
C. 党纲通过宣告中国共产党的诞生
D. 中国共产党是新型的革命政党
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1921年中共“一大”上通过的《中国共产党纲领》（英文译稿）中规定：“以无产阶级革命军队推翻资产阶级，由劳动阶级重建国家，直至消灭阶级差别；……废除资本私有制，没收一切生产资料，如机器、土地、厂房、半成品等，归社会所有。”对上述材料的解读，不正确的是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The "Program of the Communist Party of China" (English translation) adopted at the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China in 1921 stipulates: "The proletarian revolutionary army will overthrow the bourgeoisie, and the working class will rebuild the country until class differences are eliminated; ... abolish private ownership of capital, confiscate all means of production, such as machines, land, factories, semi-finished products, etc., and return them to society." The incorrect interpretation of the above material is
A. The Communist Party of China lacks a correct understanding of China's national conditions
B. The Communist Party of China takes anti-imperialism and anti-feudalism as its main tasks
C. The adoption of the party program announced the birth of the Communist Party of China
D. The Communist Party of China is a new type of revolutionary party

A: 新旧学之间矛盾不可调和

D. 废八股断送读书人政治前途

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1898, Liang Qichao and more than 100 candidates jointly petitioned to abolish the eight-legged essay system for selecting scholars. Nearly 10,000 candidates who participated in the imperial examination "heard of Qichao's move, and were jealous of it like an irreconcilable enemy, spread rumors, and were almost beaten." This incident shows that
A. The contradiction between the new and old schools of thought is irreconcilable
B. Intellectuals are extremely conservative in politics
C. The reform lacks a broad social foundation
D. Abolishing the eight-legged essay ruined the political future of scholars

Question: 某学者评唐朝三省制时指出:“凡未加盖‘中书门下之印，未经政事堂议决副署，而由皇帝直接发出的命令，在当时是被认为违制的，不能为下属机关所承认。冶这里所谓“违制”的论断，主要指皇帝背离了
A: 尚书省负责执行诏令的定制

某学者评唐朝三省制时指出:“凡未加盖‘中书门下之印，未经政事堂议决副署，而由皇帝直接发出的命令，在当时是被认为违制的，不能为下属机关所承认。冶这里所谓“违制”的论断，主要指皇帝背离了

The next question is about China's history.
A scholar commented on the three-province system of the Tang Dynasty and pointed out: "Any order issued directly by the emperor without the seal of the 'Zhongshu Menxia' and the signature of the Zhengshitang was considered to be against the rules at that time and could not be recognized by the subordinate agencies. The so-called "violation of the rules" here mainly refers to the emperor's deviation from
A. The Shangshu Province is responsible for executing the imperial edict
B. The Menxia Province is responsible for drafting the imperial edict
C. The system that the imperial edict must be decided by the Zhengshitang
D. The Zhongshu Province supervises the local government affairs

Question: “走向世界丛书”于20世纪80年代开始出版，所收著作记录了近代国人亲历西方的见闻感言，如容闳的《西学东渐记》、康有为的《欧洲十一国游记》等，反响极大。该丛书的出版：a 展现了近代国人走出国门、了解世界的历程；b 改变了近代中国闭关锁国、盲目自大的局面；c 为中国改革开放、融入世界提供了历史借鉴；d 开创了中国独立自主的和平外交新局面
A: ab
B: bd
C: bc
D: ac
options:
A. ab
B. bd
C. bc
D. ac

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The "Going to the World Series" began to be published in the 1980s. The works collected recorded the experiences and feelings of modern Chinese people in the West, such as Yung Wing's "The Spread of Western Learning to the East" and Kang Youwei's "Travels in Eleven European Countries", which received great response. The publication of this series: a shows the process of modern Chinese people going abroad and understanding the world; b changed the situation of modern China's isolation and blind arrogance; c provided historical reference for China's reform and opening up and integration into the world; d created a new situation of China's independent and peaceful diplomacy
A. ab
B. bd
C. bc
D. ac

Question: 19世纪六七十年代，外国人将自己的名字租借给中国人经办新式企业的做法，在通商口岸较为盛行。这一做法

The next question is about China's history.
In the 1860s and 1970s, the practice of foreigners renting their names to Chinese to run new enterprises was quite popular in the trading ports. This practice
A. increased the inflow of foreign capital into China
B. was conducive to the development of new social classes in China
C. led to the emergence of a high tide of private factory establishment
D. reversed China's foreign trade deficit

Question: 一位学者评价说:“当时知识分子不但没有全盘反传统，而且使不少被尘封或淹没了的传统重现光芒。例如，不登大雅之堂的白话小说，成了中国文学史的重要内容;作为传统文化的民间文学，第一次真正进入了大学的学术殿堂。”这一观点认为新文化运动

B: 混淆了先进与落后的界限
C: 充分肯定了文言文的价值
D: 存在对旧文化的传承与创新

For example, vernacular novels, which were not worthy of being published, became an important part of Chinese literary history; folk literature, as a traditional culture, truly entered the academic halls of universities for the first time." This view believes that the New Culture Movement
A. opposed old morality and advocated modern culture
B. confused the boundaries between advanced and backward
C. fully affirmed the value of classical Chinese
D. existed in the inheritance and innovation of old culture

Question: “高产卫星”是“大跃进”时期常用词。有人以《人民日报》为例做统计，“高产卫星”一词1957年未有文章使用，1958年共85篇，1959年共15篇，而1960年只有1篇，并且还是“陕西长安县的一个学习组说1958年种的‘三亩六分高产卫星田’不尊重‘庄稼生长的规律’了”，下列对“大跃进”的准确认识有：a “大跃进”只在农业领域展开；b “高产卫星”折射“大跃进”浮夸盛行；c 1958年“大跃进”快速推进；d 1960年基层队“大跃进”有所反思
A: abd
B: abc
C: bcd
D: acd
options:
A. abd
B. abc
C. bcd
D. acd

C. bcd

en:
The next question is about China's history.

The term "high-yield satellite" was not used in any article in 1957, 85 articles in 1958, 15 articles in 1959, and only one article in 1960. A. abd
B. abc
C. bcd
D. acd

A. 中国加入了《关税与贸易总协定》
B. 处于布雷顿森林体系的框架下

en:
The next question is about China's history.

A. China joined the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
B. It was under the framework of the Bretton Woods system
C. China was facing a full-scale civil war
D. Shanghai had fallen into an "isolated island"

Question: 1980年12月11日，温州人章华妹领到了自己期待很久的营业执照，成为全国第一个个体工商户。但长期以来，我们一直把非公有制经济看做是社会主义经济的对立面，谈“私”色变，早在30年前，温州和全国多数城市一样，做个“个体户”并不是件光鲜的事。“女孩子当个体户，连对象都找不着……”。使人们摆脱这种恐“私”症困扰的制度性决策是
A: 1999九届人大二次会议正式确立的依法治国战略

en:

A. The rule of law strategy formally established at the second session of the Ninth National People's Congress in 1999

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Song Yingxing of the Ming Dynasty recorded in "The Exploitation of the Works of Nature": "Wash away the red ink and dirt from the waste paper, soak it and put it into the tank for recycling. The energy of boiling and soaking in the whole province can still be used to make paper, and the consumption is not much. In the south of the Yangtze River, where bamboo is cheap, people don't think so. In the north, people pick up the pieces of paper on the ground and recycle them, which is called resurrection paper." From this, we can know that resurrection paper: a production is spread all over the country; b reduced production costs; c more complicated manufacturing process; d expanded the source of raw materials
A. ab
B. bd
C. cd
D. ac

Question: 1920 年，梁启超赴欧洲考察后写道：“一百年物质的进步，比从前三千年所得还加几倍。我们人类不惟没有得着幸福，倒反带来许多灾难。好像沙漠中失路的旅人，远远望见个大黑影，拼命往前赶，以为可以靠他向导。哪知赶上几程，影子却不见了，因此无限凄惶失望。影子是谁？就是这位‘科学先生’。欧洲人做了一场科学万能的大梦……”材料表明梁启超的态度是
A: 宣传伸民权、设议院、变法 图存
B: 质疑以科学为中心的西方文明
C: 主张“中学为体，西学为用”
D: 阻止西方科学在中国传播
options:
A. 宣传伸民权、设议院、变法 图存

D. 阻止西方科学在中国传播

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1920, Liang Qichao wrote after visiting Europe: "The material progress of one hundred years is several times greater than that of the previous three thousand years. Not only did we humans not gain happiness, but we also brought many disasters. It's like a traveler who lost his way in the desert. He saw a big black shadow in the distance and rushed forward desperately, thinking that he could rely on it as a guide. But after catching up for a few miles, the shadow disappeared, so he was infinitely disappointed. Who is the shadow? It is this 'Mr. Science'. Europeans have a big dream that science can do everything..." The materials show that Liang Qichao's attitude is 
A. Promote the extension of civil rights, the establishment of a parliament, and reform to survive
B. Question the Western civilization centered on science
C. Advocate "Chinese learning as the body, Western learning for practical use"
D. Prevent the spread of Western science in China

A. People's Commune Movement

Question: 自19世纪60年代开始，李鸿章等洋务派官僚，先后创办了江南制造总局、金陵机器局等军事工业：19世纪70年代以后，他们又相继创办了上海轮船招商局，开平矿务局、天津电报总局等，从而建立了中国自己的近代采矿、航运和通讯事业。据此可知，当时中国
A: 经济的近代化逐步发展
B: 民族资本主义初步发展
C: 近代工业体系已逐步建立
D: 优先发展重工业成为共识
options:
A. 经济的近代化逐步发展
B. 民族资本主义初步发展
C. 近代工业体系已逐步建立
D. 优先发展重工业成为共识
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
自19世纪60年代开始，李鸿章等洋务派官僚，先后创办了江南制造总局、金陵机器局等军事工业：19世纪70年代以后，他们又相继创办了上海轮船招商局，开平矿务局、天津电报总局等，从而建立了中国自己的近代采矿、航运和通讯事业。据此可知，当时中国
A. 经济的近代化逐步发展
B. 民族资本主义初步发展
C. 近代工业体系已逐步建立
D. 优先发展重工业成为共识
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Since the 1860s, Li Hongzhang and other Westernization bureaucrats have successively established military industries such as the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau and the Jinling Machinery Bureau. After the 1870s, they successively established the Shanghai Merchants Steam Navigation Company, the Kaiping Mining Bureau, the Tianjin Telegraph Bureau, etc., thus establishing China's own modern mining, shipping and communications. Based on this, we can know that at that time, China
A. The modernization of the economy was gradually developing
B. The initial development of national capitalism
C. The modern industrial system had been gradually established
D. It became a consensus to give priority to the development of heavy industry

Question: 新中国成立时，世界已进入核时代。曾长期领导核科学事业的聂荣臻元帅回忆道：“我们国家，不可能靠购买武器来支撑国防……唯一的出路只有尽可能吸取国外先进成果，走自己研制的道路。”中国跨入原子能时代开始于
A: 20世纪50年代
B: 20世纪60年代
C: 20世纪70年代
D: 20世纪40年代
options:
A. 20世纪50年代
B. 20世纪60年代
C. 20世纪70年代
D. 20世纪40年代
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
新中国成立时，世界已进入核时代。曾长期领导核科学事业的聂荣臻元帅回忆道：“我们国家，不可能靠购买武器来支撑国防……唯一的出路只有尽可能吸取国外先进成果，走自己研制的道路。”中国跨入原子能时代开始于
A. 20世纪50年代
B. 20世纪60年代

en:
The next question is about China's history.
When the People's Republic of China was founded, the world had entered the nuclear age. Marshal Nie Rongzhen, who had long led the nuclear science cause, recalled: "Our country cannot rely on purchasing weapons to support national defense... The only way out is to absorb as much advanced foreign achievements as possible and take the path of self-development." China entered the atomic energy age in
A. 1950s
B. 1960s
C. 1970s
D. 1940s

Question: “国体初建，民权未张，是以野心家竞欲覆民政而复帝制……所幸革命之元气未消，新旧两派皆争相反对帝制自为者，而民国乃得中兴。”这段文字写于
A: 20世纪初期
B: 19世纪中期
C: 20世纪中期
D: 19世纪末期
options:
A. 20世纪初期
B. 19世纪中期

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
“国体初建，民权未张，是以野心家竞欲覆民政而复帝制……所幸革命之元气未消，新旧两派皆争相反对帝制自为者，而民国乃得中兴。”这段文字写于
A. 20世纪初期
B. 19世纪中期
C. 20世纪中期
D. 19世纪末期
en:
The next question is about China's history.
"When the state system was first established, civil rights were not yet expanded, so ambitious people competed to overthrow civil government and restore the monarchy... Fortunately, the revolutionary spirit had not yet disappeared, and both the old and new factions competed to oppose the monarchy, and the Republic of China was revived." This passage was written in
A. Early 20th century
B. Mid-19th century
C. Mid-20th century
D. Late 19th century

Question: 近代一有识之士曾说：“一国所得，诸国安然而享之；一国所求，诸国群起而助之，是不啻驱西洋诸国，使之协以谋我。”上述言论针对的是
A: 领事裁判权
B: 居住及租地权
C: 片面最惠国待遇
D: “门户开放”政策
options:
A. 领事裁判权
B. 居住及租地权
C. 片面最惠国待遇

zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
近代一有识之士曾说：“一国所得，诸国安然而享之；一国所求，诸国群起而助之，是不啻驱西洋诸国，使之协以谋我。”上述言论针对的是
A. 领事裁判权
B. 居住及租地权
C. 片面最惠国待遇
D. “门户开放”政策
en:
The next question is about China's history.
A wise man in modern times once said: "What one country gains, other countries enjoy peacefully; what one country seeks, other countries come together to help it, which is tantamount to driving the Western countries to cooperate with us." The above remarks are directed at 
A. Consular jurisdiction
B. Right of residence and lease of land
C. Unilateral most-favored-nation treatment
D. "Open door" policy

Question: 19世纪八九十年代，李鸿章在为格致书院所出考题中，曾问到西方测温、测热、测电的方法，问到西方平弧三角与《周髀算经》的关系，问到西方关于64种化学物质在中国语言为何物┅┅。这说明当时中国人
A: 开始开眼看世界
B: 坚持“中体西用”
C: 普遍接受西式教育
D: 关注西方科技
options:
A. 开始开眼看世界
B. 坚持“中体西用”
C. 普遍接受西式教育
D. 关注西方科技
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
19世纪八九十年代，李鸿章在为格致书院所出考题中，曾问到西方测温、测热、测电的方法，问到西方平弧三角与《周髀算经》的关系，问到西方关于64种化学物质在中国语言为何物┅┅。这说明当时中国人
A. 开始开眼看世界
B. 坚持“中体西用”
C. 普遍接受西式教育
D. 关注西方科技
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the 1880s and 1890s, Li Hongzhang asked about Western methods of measuring temperature, heat, and electricity, the relationship between Western parallel arc trigonometry and Zhoubi Suanjing, and what the 64 chemical substances in the West meant in Chinese... This shows that the Chinese at that time
A. began to open their eyes to the world
B. insisted on "Chinese learning for substance and Western learning for practical use"
C. generally accepted Western education
D. paid attention to Western science and technology

Question: 据统计，1954年1月到4月，中国科学院图书馆上海分馆俄文书刊借阅总数为1953年同期的5倍，为1952年同期的50倍，东北各研究所俄文书刊借阅量也大幅增加。这表明当时
A: 对苏联经验的反思蔚然成风
B: 科学研究已与国际前沿接轨
C: 科教兴国战略已展开
D: 工业化建设需求迫切
options:
A. 对苏联经验的反思蔚然成风
B. 科学研究已与国际前沿接轨

zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
据统计，1954年1月到4月，中国科学院图书馆上海分馆俄文书刊借阅总数为1953年同期的5倍，为1952年同期的50倍，东北各研究所俄文书刊借阅量也大幅增加。这表明当时

en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to statistics, from January to April 1954, the total number of Russian books and periodicals borrowed from the Shanghai Branch of the Library of the Chinese Academy of Sciences was five times that of the same period in 1953 and 50 times that of the same period in 1952. The number of Russian books and periodicals borrowed from various research institutes in Northeast China also increased significantly. This shows that at that time
A. Reflection on the Soviet experience became popular
B. Scientific research was in line with the international frontier
C. The strategy of rejuvenating the country through science and education had been launched
D. The demand for industrialization construction was urgent

Question: 据《中国近代报刊史》，《时务报》初创时，每期只销4000份左右，半年后增至7000分，一年后达到13000份，最多时销达17000份，创造了当时国内报纸发行量的最高记录。这一现象说明
A: 《时务报》开创了国人办报的先例
B: 维新派有效利用新式媒介开启民智
C: 国人所办的报纸市场需求极大
D: 通俗性报刊广受普通民众欢迎
options:
A. 《时务报》开创了国人办报的先例
B. 维新派有效利用新式媒介开启民智
C. 国人所办的报纸市场需求极大
D. 通俗性报刊广受普通民众欢迎
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
据《中国近代报刊史》，《时务报》初创时，每期只销4000份左右，半年后增至7000分，一年后达到13000份，最多时销达17000份，创造了当时国内报纸发行量的最高记录。这一现象说明
A. 《时务报》开创了国人办报的先例
B. 维新派有效利用新式媒介开启民智
C. 国人所办的报纸市场需求极大
D. 通俗性报刊广受普通民众欢迎
en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to the History of Modern Chinese Newspapers and Periodicals, when Shiwu Bao was first established, each issue only sold about 4,000 copies, which increased to 7,000 copies half a year later, and reached 13,000 copies a year later. The peak sales reached 17,000 copies, setting a record for the highest domestic newspaper circulation at that time. This phenomenon shows that 
A. Shiwu Bao set a precedent for Chinese people to run newspapers 
B. The reformists effectively used new media to enlighten the people 
C. There is a huge market demand for newspapers run by Chinese people 
D. Popular newspapers and periodicals are widely welcomed by ordinary people

Question: 1840年起至1930年间，中国共开放77个城市作为通商口岸，通商口岸是中国近代史上的特殊产物。毛泽东认为，帝国主义利用通商口岸为基地，造成“买办的和高利贷的剥削网”，培养出为帝国主义服务的“买办阶级和商业高利贷阶级”，便利其剥削广大中国农民。毛泽东对近代通商口岸的观察所体现的视角是
A: 文明演进视角
B: 全球视角
C: 近代化视角
D: 阶级斗争视角
options:
A. 文明演进视角
B. 全球视角
C. 近代化视角
D. 阶级斗争视角
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1840年起至1930年间，中国共开放77个城市作为通商口岸，通商口岸是中国近代史上的特殊产物。毛泽东认为，帝国主义利用通商口岸为基地，造成“买办的和高利贷的剥削网”，培养出为帝国主义服务的“买办阶级和商业高利贷阶级”，便利其剥削广大中国农民。毛泽东对近代通商口岸的观察所体现的视角是
A. 文明演进视角
B. 全球视角
C. 近代化视角
D. 阶级斗争视角
en:
The next question is about China's history.
From 1840 to 1930, China opened 77 cities as trading ports. Trading ports are a special product of China's modern history. Mao Zedong believed that imperialism used trading ports as a base to create a "comprador and usury exploitation network" and cultivate a "comprador class and commercial usury class" that served imperialism, facilitating its exploitation of the vast number of Chinese farmers. Mao Zedong's observation of modern trading ports reflects the perspective of 
A. Civilization evolution perspective 
B. Global perspective 
C. Modernization perspective 
D. Class struggle perspective

Question: 1952年我国高校进行院系调整，如调整后的天津大学下设土木建筑、电信、机械等7个工科系、20个专业和13个专修科，从综合型大学转变为多科性工业大学。这种调整主要是为了
A: 提升国民的科技素养
B: 推动天津经济建设发展
C: 培养经济建设专门人才
D: 促进国民经济的恢复
options:
A. 提升国民的科技素养
B. 推动天津经济建设发展
C. 培养经济建设专门人才
D. 促进国民经济的恢复
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1952年我国高校进行院系调整，如调整后的天津大学下设土木建筑、电信、机械等7个工科系、20个专业和13个专修科，从综合型大学转变为多科性工业大学。这种调整主要是为了
A. 提升国民的科技素养
B. 推动天津经济建设发展
C. 培养经济建设专门人才
D. 促进国民经济的恢复
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1952, my country's colleges and universities adjusted their departments. For example, after the adjustment, Tianjin University had 7 engineering departments, including civil engineering, telecommunications, and machinery, 20 majors, and 13 specialized courses, transforming from a comprehensive university to a multidisciplinary industrial university. This adjustment was mainly to
A. Improve the scientific and technological literacy of the people
B. Promote the development of Tianjin's economic construction
C. Cultivate specialized talents for economic construction
D. Promote the recovery of the national economy

Question: 甲午国殇，催化了维新思想的发酵和维新群体的聚合，并很快发展成为爱国救亡的维新运动。下列事件，拉开了维新运动序幕的是
A: 创办京师大学堂
B: 签订《马关条约》
C: 颁布“明定国是”诏
D: 发动“公车上书”
options:

zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
甲午国殇，催化了维新思想的发酵和维新群体的聚合，并很快发展成为爱国救亡的维新运动。下列事件，拉开了维新运动序幕的是
A. 创办京师大学堂

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895 catalyzed the fermentation of reformist ideas and the gathering of reformist groups, and soon developed into a patriotic and national salvation reform movement. The following events kicked off the reform movement
A. Founding of the Imperial University of Peking
B. Signing of the Treaty of Shimonoseki
C. Issuing the "Decree of State Affairs"
D. Launching the "Petition to the Emperor"

Question: 芜湖是明代中后期著名的浆染业中心，当时松江的白布也要送到芜湖浆染，故有“织造尚松江，浆染尚芜湖”之说，这一历史现象反映出
A: 抑商政策阻碍区域经济发展
B: 手工业技术水平日趋平衡
C: 区域间有着不同的市场需求
D: 商品生产呈现区域化分工
options:
A. 抑商政策阻碍区域经济发展
B. 手工业技术水平日趋平衡
C. 区域间有着不同的市场需求
D. 商品生产呈现区域化分工
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
芜湖是明代中后期著名的浆染业中心，当时松江的白布也要送到芜湖浆染，故有“织造尚松江，浆染尚芜湖”之说，这一历史现象反映出
A. 抑商政策阻碍区域经济发展
B. 手工业技术水平日趋平衡
C. 区域间有着不同的市场需求
D. 商品生产呈现区域化分工
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Wuhu was a famous dyeing center in the middle and late Ming Dynasty. At that time, white cloth from Songjiang was also sent to Wuhu for dyeing. Therefore, there was a saying that "weaving is in Songjiang, and dyeing is in Wuhu". This historical phenomenon reflects
A. The policy of suppressing business hinders the development of regional economy
B. The level of handicraft technology is becoming more balanced
C. There are different market demands between regions
D. Commodity production shows regional division of labor

Question: 上海发昌机器厂创立于1866年，最初只是一个手工锻铁作坊，专为外商船坞打造修配船用零件，1873年发展为机器制造厂。后来，它在外商船厂的压迫排挤下，趋于衰落，1900年被英资耶松船厂所吞并。下列关于该厂说法正确的是
A: 其壮大得益于政府的支持
B: 它是中国最早的近代企业
C: 它是由官营手工业转型而来
D: 其兴衰受外商势力影响很大
options:
A. 其壮大得益于政府的支持
B. 它是中国最早的近代企业
C. 它是由官营手工业转型而来
D. 其兴衰受外商势力影响很大
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
上海发昌机器厂创立于1866年，最初只是一个手工锻铁作坊，专为外商船坞打造修配船用零件，1873年发展为机器制造厂。后来，它在外商船厂的压迫排挤下，趋于衰落，1900年被英资耶松船厂所吞并。下列关于该厂说法正确的是
A. 其壮大得益于政府的支持
B. 它是中国最早的近代企业
C. 它是由官营手工业转型而来
D. 其兴衰受外商势力影响很大
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Shanghai Fachang Machinery Factory was founded in 1866. It was originally a manual iron forging workshop that specialized in making and repairing ship parts for foreign shipyards. In 1873, it developed into a machinery manufacturing plant. Later, it declined under the oppression and exclusion of foreign shipyards and was annexed by the British-owned Jesson Shipyard in 1900. Which of the following statements about the factory is correct?
A. Its growth benefited from government support
B. It was the earliest modern enterprise in China
C. It was transformed from a state-run handicraft industry
D. Its rise and fall was greatly influenced by foreign forces

Question: 据新华社对 1972 年 1 ~ 9 月外交情况的统计，中国接待外国官员和政府代表团三十多起，访问中国的有来自世界五大洲的政府代表团和各界人士。 到 1972 年底和中国建立外交关系的国家达 88 个，和 1969 年底相比，三年内翻了一番。材料表明中国
A: 打破美国孤立遏制的外交僵局
B: 切实推进新型区域外交合作
C: 重点建立与亚非的外交关系
D: 开始独立自主地步入国际舞台
options:
A. 打破美国孤立遏制的外交僵局
B. 切实推进新型区域外交合作
C. 重点建立与亚非的外交关系
D. 开始独立自主地步入国际舞台
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
据新华社对 1972 年 1 ~ 9 月外交情况的统计，中国接待外国官员和政府代表团三十多起，访问中国的有来自世界五大洲的政府代表团和各界人士。 到 1972 年底和中国建立外交关系的国家达 88 个，和 1969 年底相比，三年内翻了一番。材料表明中国
A. 打破美国孤立遏制的外交僵局
B. 切实推进新型区域外交合作
C. 重点建立与亚非的外交关系
D. 开始独立自主地步入国际舞台
en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to the statistics of the diplomatic situation of Xinhua News Agency from January to September 1972, China received more than 30 foreign officials and government delegations, and government delegations and people from all walks of life from five continents visited China. By the end of 1972, 88 countries had established diplomatic relations with China, which doubled in three years compared with the end of 1969. The data show that China
A. broke the diplomatic deadlock of isolation and containment by the United States
B. effectively promoted new regional diplomatic cooperation
C. focused on establishing diplomatic relations with Asia and Africa
D. began to independently enter the international stage

A: 对关羽的信仰符台官方意识形态的要求
B: 民众的信仰不断推高关羽“神”的地位

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Guan Yu was praised by the world for his loyalty, bravery and bravery. He was named "Loyal and Benevolent Duke" during the reign of Emperor Fuzong of Song Dynasty. He was given more titles afterwards and was named "Loyal and Brave Guan Sheng Dadi" in the Qing Dynasty. This phenomenon reflects
A. The belief in Guan Yu conforms to the requirements of the official ideology of the government
B. The belief of the people constantly pushes up the status of Guan Yu as a "god"

In the late Warring States period, Qin State built a number of large-scale water conservancy projects, such as Zhengguo Canal and Dujiangyan, some of which are still in use today. These projects were completed in Qin State mainly because of
A. smooth transportation network
B. popularization of iron production tools
C. gradual improvement of the public land system
D. strong national organizational ability

Question: 中国皇帝制度出现后，皇帝的居处称“行在所”，所用车马称“乘舆”。经皇帝批阅的文件称“御批”。皇帝有病称“不豫”。皇帝去世称“驾崩”，入葬的坟墓称“陵”。皇帝之印称“玺”。材料反映出
A: 皇帝制度顺应了当时历史潮流
B: 封建皇帝在当时具有独特权威

en:
The next question is about China's history.
After the emergence of the Chinese imperial system, the emperor's residence was called "Xingzaisuo" and the carriages he used were called "Chengyu". Documents reviewed by the emperor were called "Yupi". The emperor's illness was called "Buyu". The emperor's death was called "Jiaben" and the tomb he was buried in was called "Ling". The emperor's seal was called "Xi". The material reflects
A. The imperial system conformed to the historical trend at that time
B. The feudal emperor had unique authority at that time
C. The emperor's exclusive title reduced the restrictions on the imperial power
D. The feudal imperial power gradually strengthened with the development of the times

Question: 20世纪初，女学在中国开始兴起，几十年间中国女性走出闺阁，走向学校和职场，获得了独立和解放的可能。而这一变化在上海这些近代大都市尤为剧烈和多样。对这些现象的解释最合理的是
A: 女性解放最早兴起于上海
B: 男女间实现了权利上的平等

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early 20th century, women's education began to flourish in China. Over the past few decades, Chinese women have stepped out of their boudoirs, entered schools and the workplace, and gained the possibility of independence and liberation. This change was particularly dramatic and diverse in modern metropolises such as Shanghai. The most reasonable explanation for these phenomena is
A. Women's liberation first emerged in Shanghai
B. Equality of rights between men and women was achieved
C. The rise of women's education led to the collapse of traditional ethics
D. Political movements promoted women's liberation

Question: 苏轼曾说：“民庶之家，置庄田，招佃客，本望租课，非行仁义，然犹至水旱之岁，必须放免欠负、贷借种粮者，其心诚恐客散而田荒，后日之失必倍于今故也。”这句话反映出的主要问题是
A: 宋代地主有开展民间赈济的社会责任感
B: 宋代地主主要依靠土地剥削来积累财富
C: 宋代佃户租地有较大的选择权和自由度

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Su Shi once said: "Common people set up farms and recruit tenants, hoping to collect rent, not to practice benevolence and righteousness. However, in years of floods and droughts, they still have to forgive debts and lend money to farmers. They are sincerely afraid that the tenants will leave and the fields will be abandoned, and the loss in the future will be twice as much as it is now." The main problem reflected in this sentence is
A. Landlords in the Song Dynasty had a sense of social responsibility to carry out folk relief
B. Landlords in the Song Dynasty mainly relied on land exploitation to accumulate wealth
C. Tenants in the Song Dynasty had greater choice and freedom in renting land
D. The practice of operating land in a tenancy relationship began to appear in rural areas in the Song Dynasty

Question: 1892年，维新思想家宋恕提出“欲更官制、设议院、改试令，必自易西服始”。康有为在奏议中也不止一次提及“易服”。维新派如此重视易服的主要原因是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1892, the reformist thinker Song Shu proposed that "if you want to change the official system, set up a parliament, and change the examination system, you must start with changing to Western clothes." Kang Youwei also mentioned "changing clothes" more than once in his memorials. The main reason why the reformists attached so much importance to changing clothes is that
A. Changing clothes is easier to implement during the reform
B. It is intended to create a social atmosphere for reform
C. China needs to change its external image
D. The long gown and jacket represent conservative forces

en:
The next question is about China's history.
A historical fact can be composed of several events, and an event can be composed of several small events, which can be used to rank a series of events. The following options are consistent with the above statement
A. "Act of Succession" - "Bill of Rights" - "Glorious Revolution"
B. Economic globalization - Western European integration - Euro launch
C. Battle of Midway - Battle of Stalingrad - Battle of El Alamein
D. New China's foreign policy - good neighbor diplomacy - Sino-US diplomatic relations

Question: 20世纪初，有学者认为，“张三李四是同时人。张三记了古典来做古文；李四又记了古典，去读张三做的古文。我想：古典是古人的时事，要晓得那时的事，所以免不了翻着古典；现在两位既然同时，何妨老实说出，一目了然”。该学者旨在
A: 提倡使用白话文
B: 既反对白话文也反对文言文
C: 强调科学地看待读经问题
D: 纠正“文学革命”的形式主义倾向
options:
A. 提倡使用白话文
B. 既反对白话文也反对文言文
C. 强调科学地看待读经问题
D. 纠正“文学革命”的形式主义倾向

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early 20th century, a scholar believed that "Zhang San and Li Si were contemporaries. Zhang San memorized the classics to write classical Chinese; Li Si memorized the classics and read Zhang San's classical Chinese. I think: Classics are the current affairs of the ancients. To know what happened at that time, you can't avoid reading the classics; now that the two of them are contemporaries, why not just speak honestly, so that it is clear at a glance." The scholar aims to
A. Promote the use of vernacular Chinese
B. Oppose both vernacular Chinese and classical Chinese
C. Emphasize the scientific view of reading scriptures
D. Correct the formalism of the "literary revolution"

Question: 马士在《中华帝国对外关系史》中记载：“就茶叶出口而言，在1846年由上海出口的只占全国出口的七分之一，1851年就增长到三分之一，紧接着在1852年超过全国出口的一半，1853年又进一步几乎达到70%，此后上海一直保持着优势地位。”这说明
A: 中国传统经济格局发生变化
B: 上海是重要的通商口岸
C: 中国卷入资本主义世界市场
D: 上海取代广州贸易地位

A. 中国传统经济格局发生变化
B. 上海是重要的通商口岸
C. 中国卷入资本主义世界市场
D. 上海取代广州贸易地位

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In his History of the Foreign Relations of the Chinese Empire, Marx wrote: "As for tea exports, in 1846, Shanghai only exported one-seventh of the country's exports, but in 1851 it increased to one-third, and then in 1852 it exceeded half of the country's exports, and in 1853 it further reached almost 70%. Since then, Shanghai has maintained its dominant position." This shows that 
A. China's traditional economic structure has changed 
B. Shanghai is an important trading port 
C. China is involved in the capitalist world market 
D. Shanghai replaces Guangzhou's trade status

Question: 唐文宗太和六年（832年），宰相王涯上奏：“商人乘马，前代所禁。近日得以恣其乘骑，雕鞍银镫，装饰焕烂，从以童骑，骋以康庄，此最为僭越。伏请切令禁断。”以下对当时商人地位的判断，错误的是
A: 经济地位优越
B: 实际上没有自由民的平等地位
C: 政治地位低下
D: 遭受全社会的鄙视
options:
A. 经济地位优越
B. 实际上没有自由民的平等地位
C. 政治地位低下
D. 遭受全社会的鄙视

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the sixth year of Emperor Wenzong of Tang’s Taihe reign (832), Prime Minister Wang Ya reported: “Merchants riding horses was forbidden in previous dynasties. Recently, they are allowed to ride freely, with carved saddles and silver stirrups, and gorgeous decorations. Children can ride and gallop on the wide road. This is the most presumptuous. I humbly ask that it be strictly prohibited.” Which of the following judgments about the status of merchants at that time is wrong?
A. Superior economic status
B. In fact, they do not have equal status with free people
C. Low political status
D. Despised by the whole society

Question: 2012年7月18日，《深圳特区报》刊登《科举制之美》一文：“科举产生出了一大批……政治家、众多有杰出贡献的思想家……外交家等，通过科举而施展才华，都是中华民族的英才。”这充分说明了
A: 古代官吏主要来源于科举选官

The next question is about China's history.

This fully illustrates that
A. Ancient officials mainly came from the imperial examination selection
B. The imperial examination system completely abandoned the concept of family class
C. The imperial examination system is conducive to selecting practical talents for society
D. The imperial examination system fully meets the needs of social development

en:
The next question is about China's history.
After the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895, Liang Qichao proposed the "Poetry Revolution" and wrote a poem "Great is China... The land is rich in products, and it is no exaggeration to say that it is a land of abundance. Don't you see that the three islands of Britain and Japan are rising, let alone China!" This reflects that the "Poetry Revolution"
A. advocated the idea of democratic revolution
B. became the beginning of reformist ideas
C. promoted the vernacular movement
D. adapted to the need to save the nation

Question: 李鸿章在《筹议制造轮船未可裁撤折》中指出：“若我果深通其法，愈学愈精，愈推愈广，安见百数十年后不能攘夷而自立耶？”据此可知，此时的李鸿章力主推广
A: 治国法律
B: 教育之法
C: 经商之法
D: 制造之法
options:
A. 治国法律
B. 教育之法

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
李鸿章在《筹议制造轮船未可裁撤折》中指出：“若我果深通其法，愈学愈精，愈推愈广，安见百数十年后不能攘夷而自立耶？”据此可知，此时的李鸿章力主推广

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Li Hongzhang pointed out in the memorial "On the Cancellation of the Construction of Steamships": "If I really understand the method, learn more and more, and promote it more and more, how can I not be able to drive out the foreigners and establish myself in a hundred or ten years?" Based on this, we can know that at this time, Li Hongzhang strongly advocated the promotion of
A. Laws of governing the country
B. Laws of education
C. Laws of doing business
D. Laws of manufacturing

Question: 1896年，江苏著名实业家荣德生、荣宗敬决定筹办面粉厂。在办厂审批时因为没有送礼遭到当地士绅的反对，幸好两江总督刘坤一是倡导办实业的官员，他一连下了八道要求地方官支持实业的批示，最终才确保了保兴面粉厂、振兴纱厂等企业的创办。这说明
A: 政府官员廉洁
B: 民企兴办艰难
C: 总督办事高效
D: 封建势力强大
options:
A. 政府官员廉洁
B. 民企兴办艰难
C. 总督办事高效

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1896, Rong Desheng and Rong Zongjing, two famous industrialists in Jiangsu, decided to set up a flour mill. When the factory was approved, they were opposed by local gentry because they did not give gifts. Fortunately, Liu Kunyi, the governor-general of Liangjiang, was an official who advocated the establishment of industry. He issued eight instructions in a row asking local officials to support industry, and finally ensured the establishment of Baoxing Flour Mill, Zhenxing Cotton Mill and other enterprises. This shows
A. Government officials are honest
B. It is difficult for private enterprises to start
C. The governor is efficient
D. The feudal forces are strong

Question: 黄崇德是16世纪一位典型徽商。最初他只是经营棉布、粮食等，后获得政府许可，转而从事利润更大的食盐贸易，积累了巨额财富，用于购田置地。这说明当时：a 农产品大量进入商品流通领域；b 农本思想依然占主导地位；c 政府放弃对食盐贸易的控制；d 商人社会地位显著提高
A: bd
B: ad
C: ab
D: bc
options:
A. bd
B. ad
C. ab
D. bc
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
黄崇德是16世纪一位典型徽商。最初他只是经营棉布、粮食等，后获得政府许可，转而从事利润更大的食盐贸易，积累了巨额财富，用于购田置地。这说明当时：a 农产品大量进入商品流通领域；b 农本思想依然占主导地位；c 政府放弃对食盐贸易的控制；d 商人社会地位显著提高

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Huang Chongde was a typical Huizhou merchant in the 16th century. Initially, he only dealt in cotton cloth and grain, but later, with government permission, he switched to the more profitable salt trade, accumulating huge wealth and using it to buy land. This shows that at that time: a. agricultural products entered the commodity circulation field in large quantities; b. agricultural-based thinking still dominated; c. the government gave up control over the salt trade; d. the social status of merchants improved significantly
A. bd
B. ad
C. ab
D. bc

Question: 某学者评价启蒙运动说:“‘进步’实际上已经成为哲学家的一种意识形态，他们坚信自然科学将会让人类更有力地支配整个世界，而人类理性则引领每个人走向自由，并建立起一个繁荣、公正、平等的社会。”引文所想表达的深层含义是
A: 近代科学追求王权公平
B: 启蒙运动倡导阶级平等
C: 哲学意识支配世界繁荣
D: 理性思考引领社会进步
options:
A. 近代科学追求王权公平
B. 启蒙运动倡导阶级平等
C. 哲学意识支配世界繁荣

en:
The next question is about China's history.
A scholar commented on the Enlightenment: "'Progress' has actually become an ideology of philosophers. They firmly believe that natural science will enable humans to dominate the world more powerfully, while human reason will lead everyone to freedom and establish a prosperous, fair and equal society." The deeper meaning of the quotation is 
A. Modern science pursues royal justice
B. The Enlightenment advocates class equality
C. Philosophical consciousness dominates world prosperity
D. Rational thinking leads social progress

Question: 改革开放后，中共中央明确将中共八大作为探索中国社会主义建设道路的开端。这是因为中共八大
A: 实现了工作重心向社会主义现代化建设的转变
B: 全面总结了新民主主义革命的经验

After the reform and opening up, the CPC Central Committee clearly regarded the Eighth National Congress of the CPC as the beginning of exploring the path of China's socialist construction. This is because the Eighth National Congress of the CPC
A. realized the shift of the focus of work to socialist modernization construction
B. comprehensively summarized the experience of the New Democratic Revolution
C. objectively analyzed the domestic situation and changes in the main contradictions at that time
D. clearly put forward the theory of the primary stage of socialism

Question: 孙中山曾有言：“兄弟曾听人说，民族革命是要尽灭满洲民族，这话大错。”1912年1月1日，孙中山在临时大总统宣言书中宣布：“国家之本，在于人民。合汉、满、蒙、回、藏诸地为一国，即合汉、满、蒙、回、藏诸族为一人，是曰民族之统一。”由上述材料可知，孙中山对中国近代民族主义理论的积极贡献是
A: 是中国近代民族主义主张的最早提出者和政治实践者
B: 推翻了满清贵族的统治，完成了“光复”国家的大业
C: 实现了民族革命和民主革命的完美结合
D: 提出“民族平等”“五族共和”，力避种族屠杀、国家分裂
options:
A. 是中国近代民族主义主张的最早提出者和政治实践者
B. 推翻了满清贵族的统治，完成了“光复”国家的大业
C. 实现了民族革命和民主革命的完美结合
D. 提出“民族平等”“五族共和”，力避种族屠杀、国家分裂

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
孙中山曾有言：“兄弟曾听人说，民族革命是要尽灭满洲民族，这话大错。”1912年1月1日，孙中山在临时大总统宣言书中宣布：“国家之本，在于人民。合汉、满、蒙、回、藏诸地为一国，即合汉、满、蒙、回、藏诸族为一人，是曰民族之统一。”由上述材料可知，孙中山对中国近代民族主义理论的积极贡献是
A. 是中国近代民族主义主张的最早提出者和政治实践者

D. 提出“民族平等”“五族共和”，力避种族屠杀、国家分裂
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Sun Yat-sen once said: "I have heard people say that the national revolution is to destroy the Manchurian nation. This is totally wrong." On January 1, 1912, Sun Yat-sen announced in the Declaration of the Provisional President: "The foundation of the country lies in the people. The union of Han, Manchu, Mongolian, Hui, and Tibetan areas into one country is the union of Han, Manchu, Mongolian, Hui, and Tibetan peoples into one person, which is called national unity." From the above materials, we can know that Sun Yat-sen's positive contribution to China's modern nationalism theory is
A. He was the earliest proposer and political practitioner of China's modern nationalism
B. He overthrew the rule of the Qing nobles and completed the great cause of "restoring" the country
C. He achieved the perfect combination of national revolution and democratic revolution
D. He proposed "national equality" and "five-nation republic" to avoid racial genocide and national division

Question: 孔子是儒家学派的创始人，汉代崇尚儒学，尊《尚书》等五部书为经典，记录孔子言论的《论语》却不在“五经”之中，对此合理的解释时
A: 儒学思想植根于久远的历史传统
B: 汉代儒学背离了孔子的儒学思想
C: “五经”为阐发孔子儒学思想而作
D: 儒学传统由于秦始皇焚书而断绝
options:
A. 儒学思想植根于久远的历史传统
B. 汉代儒学背离了孔子的儒学思想
C. “五经”为阐发孔子儒学思想而作
D. 儒学传统由于秦始皇焚书而断绝

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
孔子是儒家学派的创始人，汉代崇尚儒学，尊《尚书》等五部书为经典，记录孔子言论的《论语》却不在“五经”之中，对此合理的解释时

D. 儒学传统由于秦始皇焚书而断绝
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Confucius is the founder of the Confucian school. The Han Dynasty revered Confucianism and respected five books such as the Book of Documents as classics. However, the Analects, which records Confucius's remarks, is not among the "Five Classics". The reasonable explanation for this is
A. Confucianism is rooted in a long-standing historical tradition
B. Confucianism in the Han Dynasty deviated from Confucius' Confucianism
C. The "Five Classics" were written to expound Confucius' Confucianism
D. The Confucian tradition was cut off due to the burning of books by Qin Shihuang

Question: 1949年9月21日，中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议在北平召开。出席大会的正式代表、候补代表及特邀代表共662名，有十分广泛的代表性和民主性。会议的主要任务是集中全国各族人民的意志，制定中国人民自己的宪章，组织中国人民自己的中央政府。这反映出
A: 人民政权得到巩固
B: 人民真正成为国家的主人
C: 人民代表大会制度的确立
D: 人民生活水平提高
options:
A. 人民政权得到巩固
B. 人民真正成为国家的主人
C. 人民代表大会制度的确立
D. 人民生活水平提高

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1949年9月21日，中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议在北平召开。出席大会的正式代表、候补代表及特邀代表共662名，有十分广泛的代表性和民主性。会议的主要任务是集中全国各族人民的意志，制定中国人民自己的宪章，组织中国人民自己的中央政府。这反映出

en:
The next question is about China's history.
On September 21, 1949, the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference was held in Beijing. There were 662 formal representatives, alternate representatives and special invited representatives attending the conference, which was very representative and democratic. The main task of the conference was to concentrate the will of the people of all ethnic groups in the country, formulate the Chinese people's own constitution, and organize the Chinese people's own central government. This reflects
A. The people's political power has been consolidated
B. The people have truly become the masters of the country
C. The establishment of the people's congress system
D. The improvement of people's living standards

A: 休养生息造成消费观念的改变

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
汉初，官方禁止商人“衣丝乘车”，但后来一些商人“假二千石(官员级别)舆服导从作倡乐，奢侈日甚”。这反映出

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early Han Dynasty, the government prohibited merchants from wearing silk and riding in carriages, but later some merchants "pretended to be officials of the rank of 2,000-stone officials, and used their followers to perform music and entertainment, becoming more and more extravagant." This reflects
A. The change in consumption concepts caused by recuperation
B. The original regulations were challenged by the development of commerce
C. The court's policy of suppressing commerce underwent a major change
D. The social status of officials and merchants gradually became consistent

Question: 清末传教士明恩溥记述：“促使中国学子年复一年地坚持科举考试，有的直到九十高龄终于拿到文凭方可罢休，有的则死于这一过程中。功名利禄一类是无法说清楚的……九十高龄之后，即便考中又怎么样？唯一的解释是他天生具有忍耐的禀赋。”该材料

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Ming Enpu, a missionary in the late Qing Dynasty, wrote: "It urged Chinese students to persist in the imperial examinations year after year. Some of them did not give up until they were 90 years old and finally got their diplomas, while others died in the process. It is impossible to explain fame, wealth and status... After 90 years old, what does it matter if he passes the exam? The only explanation is that he is born with the gift of patience." This material
A. reflects the value orientation of students
B. shows the ignorance of students under the imperial examination system
C. reflects that the imperial examination system has lost its talent selection function
D. criticizes students for pursuing fame, wealth and status

Question: 据清代档案《户部汇题各省民数谷数清册》统计，咸丰元年（1851年）尚有完整的全国人口记录，咸丰三年起，南方多省册报残阙，人口遽降。造成这种状况的主要原因是
A: 列强发动侵华战争，户籍管理受冲击
B: 清政府调整政策，放松了户籍管理
C: 农民起义爆发，冲击了旧的统治秩序
D: 清朝吏治腐败，户籍管理混乱
options:
A. 列强发动侵华战争，户籍管理受冲击
B. 清政府调整政策，放松了户籍管理
C. 农民起义爆发，冲击了旧的统治秩序

据清代档案《户部汇题各省民数谷数清册》统计，咸丰元年（1851年）尚有完整的全国人口记录，咸丰三年起，南方多省册报残阙，人口遽降。造成这种状况的主要原因是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to the Qing Dynasty archives "The Ministry of Households' Compilation of Population and Grain in Each Province", there was a complete national population record in the first year of Emperor Xianfeng (1851). Since the third year of Emperor Xianfeng, the population of many southern provinces has been incomplete and the population has dropped sharply. The main reasons for this situation are:
A. The foreign powers launched a war of aggression against China, which impacted the household registration management
B. The Qing government adjusted its policies and relaxed the household registration management
C. The peasant uprising broke out, impacting the old ruling order
D. The Qing Dynasty's officialdom was corrupt and the household registration management was chaotic

Question: 《汉书》有“《公羊董仲舒治狱》十六篇”，主张凡是违背了“三纲五常”准则的，一律要按照《春秋》经义予以严惩。汉宣帝时期，桓宽在《盐铁论》中说：“故《春秋》之治狱，论心定罪。志善而违于法者免，志恶而合于法者诛。”由此可见，这一时期的“春秋决狱”
A: 造成了法律与伦理的冲突
B: 渗透了外儒内法的理念
C: 呈现出法律儒家化特征
D: 蕴含着一定的理性化色彩

zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《汉书》有“《公羊董仲舒治狱》十六篇”，主张凡是违背了“三纲五常”准则的，一律要按照《春秋》经义予以严惩。汉宣帝时期，桓宽在《盐铁论》中说：“故《春秋》之治狱，论心定罪。志善而违于法者免，志恶而合于法者诛。”由此可见，这一时期的“春秋决狱”
A. 造成了法律与伦理的冲突
B. 渗透了外儒内法的理念
C. 呈现出法律儒家化特征
D. 蕴含着一定的理性化色彩
en:
The next question is about China's history.
The "Book of Han" contains "Sixteen Chapters of Gongyang Dong Zhongshu's Judicial Administration", which advocates that anyone who violates the "Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues" should be severely punished in accordance with the "Spring and Autumn Annals". During the reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, Huan Kuan said in "Salt and Iron Discussions": "Therefore, the "Spring and Autumn Annals" judges the case based on the heart. Those who have good intentions but violate the law are exempted, and those who have evil intentions but comply with the law are punished." It can be seen that the "Spring and Autumn Judicial Administration" of this period
A. caused a conflict between law and ethics
B. permeated the concept of Confucianism outside and law inside
C. showed the Confucian characteristics of law
D. contained a certain rational color

A: 追求平等是民国时期政治斗争核心
B: 民国时期中国教育发生根本变化
C: 民国时期重视公民意识教育
D: 辛亥革命后民主共和观念深入人心
options:

B. 民国时期中国教育发生根本变化

en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the Republic of China period, the fourth grade primary school textbook "Equality" wrote: "There is no class distinction in the Republic, everyone is equal and governed by the same law... Although he is the president, he must abide by the law and cannot bully others. Once he is dismissed, he is no different from ordinary people." This shows that
A. The pursuit of equality was the core of political struggle during the Republic of China period
B. China's education underwent fundamental changes during the Republic of China period
C. The Republic of China attached importance to civic awareness education
D. After the Revolution of 1911, the concept of democracy and republic was deeply rooted in people's hearts

Question: 人们经常用国内生产总值（简称GDP）占世界总量的比重来论证本国的国际地位及发展方向。但也有人以1840年中国的GDP是世界的33%，但之后就逐步沦为半殖民地；而1949年中国的GDP虽是世界的6%，却赢得了真正的独立并逐步走向大国这些史实来反对GDP决定论。据此，下列该现象分析最为合理的是
A: 决定GDP变化的经济性质才是真正决定国家的地位和发展方向的
B: GDP的确能反映经济发展状况，可以证实国家的地位和发展方向
C: GDP只能反映当时经济状况，故不能反映国家的地位和发展方向
D: GDP的国际地位变化趋势经常与该国国际地位变化趋势成反方向
options:
A. 决定GDP变化的经济性质才是真正决定国家的地位和发展方向的
B. GDP的确能反映经济发展状况，可以证实国家的地位和发展方向
C. GDP只能反映当时经济状况，故不能反映国家的地位和发展方向
D. GDP的国际地位变化趋势经常与该国国际地位变化趋势成反方向

en:
The next question is about China's history.
People often use the proportion of gross domestic product (GDP) in the world's total to prove the country's international status and development direction. However, some people also use the historical facts that China's GDP in 1840 was 33% of the world's GDP, but then it gradually became a semi-colony; and in 1949, although China's GDP was 6% of the world's GDP, it won true independence and gradually became a great power to oppose GDP determinism. Based on this, the following analysis of this phenomenon is the most reasonable
A. The economic nature that determines the change of GDP is the real determination of the country's status and development direction
B. GDP can indeed reflect the economic development situation and can confirm the country's status and development direction
C. GDP can only reflect the economic situation at the time, so it cannot reflect the country's status and development direction
D. The trend of GDP's international status changes is often in the opposite direction of the country's international status changes

Question: 《春秋繁露》曰：“大富则骄，大贫则忧……使富者足以示贵而不至于骄，贫者足以养生而不至于忧，以此为度而调均之，是以财不匮而上下相安，故易治也。”在此，董仲舒提出的治国理念是
A: 强制去富以抑其骄
B: 上下相安利国益民
C: 劫富济贫以均贫富
D: 竭力济贫以抚其忧
options:
A. 强制去富以抑其骄
B. 上下相安利国益民
C. 劫富济贫以均贫富
D. 竭力济贫以抚其忧
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《春秋繁露》曰：“大富则骄，大贫则忧……使富者足以示贵而不至于骄，贫者足以养生而不至于忧，以此为度而调均之，是以财不匮而上下相安，故易治也。”在此，董仲舒提出的治国理念是

B. 上下相安利国益民
C. 劫富济贫以均贫富

en:
The next question is about China's history.
"Chunqiu Fanlu" says: "The rich will be arrogant, the poor will be worried... Make the rich show their nobility without being arrogant, and the poor live a healthy life without being worried. With this as the standard, balance them. Therefore, there will be no shortage of money and the upper and lower classes will be at peace, so it is easy to govern." Here, Dong Zhongshu proposed the concept of governing the country:
A. Force the rich to get rid of their arrogance
B. The upper and lower classes will be at peace, which will benefit the country and the people
C. Rob the rich to help the poor to balance the rich and the poor
D. Do your best to help the poor to relieve their worries

Question: 毛泽东在谈及学生时代喜爱阅读的一份出版物时说：“我很欣赏胡适和陈独秀写的文章，他们一度成为我效仿的榜样，取代了我已不再崇拜的梁启超和康有为。”这份出版物应该是

Question: 据叶德辉《书林清话》，五代后唐时，在宰相冯道主持下，开始将儒家“九经”校勘后刻版印刷。宋初国子监有书版四千，至真宗景德二年，书版剧增至十万。此外中央崇文院、司天监、秘书监等机构也都大量刻书。宋朝书坊遍及全国各地，所售书籍大多精雕细校。由此推断

B: 活字印刷已取代雕版印刷

en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to Ye Dehui's "Shulin Qinghua", during the Five Dynasties and the Later Tang Dynasty, under the leadership of Prime Minister Feng Dao, the Confucian "Nine Classics" began to be proofread and printed. In the early Song Dynasty, the Imperial College had 4,000 book plates, and by the second year of Jingde in the reign of Emperor Zhenzong, the number of book plates increased dramatically to 100,000. In addition, the central Chongwen Academy, Sitianjian, and the Secretary Bureau also printed a large number of books. Song Dynasty bookstores were spread all over the country, and most of the books sold were carefully carved and proofread. From this, it can be inferred that
A. Woodblock printing was limited to official book engraving
B. Movable type printing has replaced woodblock printing
C. Prime Minister Feng Dao invented woodblock printing
D. Woodblock printing has been widely used

The next question is about China's history.

A. had completed Western-style reforms of the military
B. The centralized system was conducive to combat command
C. It could obtain more extensive external assistance
D. Its modernization efforts had achieved great results

A. achieve structural adjustment of the information dissemination industry
