The next question is about China's history.
In November 1990, the UN Security Council passed Resolution 678, "authorizing member states cooperating with the Kuwaiti government to use all necessary means to restore international peace and security in the region unless Iraq fully implements the above resolutions (referring to unconditional withdrawal) on or before January 15, 1991". In accordance with this resolution, the multinational force took military action against Iraq. The Chinese government abstained from voting on the resolution. The correct analysis of this is
A. The Chinese government opposes military intervention to resolve disputes
B. The responsibility of the United Nations General Assembly is to maintain world peace and security
C. The Chinese government opposes the UN Security Council resolution
D. The UN military action violates the principle of great power consensus

Question: 明初废丞相、设顾问性质的内阁大学士，严防权臣乱政。明中后期严嵩、张居正等内阁首辅操纵朝政，权倾一时。这表明
A: 皇权渐趋衰落
B: 内阁取代六部
C: 首辅权力失控
D: 君主集权加强
options:
A. 皇权渐趋衰落
B. 内阁取代六部
C. 首辅权力失控
D. 君主集权加强

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early Ming Dynasty, the prime minister was abolished and the cabinet ministers with advisory nature were set up to prevent powerful officials from making trouble. In the middle and late Ming Dynasty, the cabinet ministers such as Yan Song and Zhang Juzheng manipulated the government and were powerful for a time. This shows that
A. The imperial power was gradually declining
B. The cabinet replaced the six ministries
C. The power of the ministers was out of control
D. The monarch's centralization was strengthened

Question: 毛泽东在一篇文章中说： “打倒帝国主义，打倒军阎，打倒贪官污吏，打倒土豪劣钾，这几个政治口号，真是不翼而飞，飞到无数乡村的青年壮年老头子小孩子妇女们的面前，一直钻进他们的脑子里去，又从他们的脑子里流到了他们的嘴上。”该文描述的这一现象表明
A: 中国革命性质开始发生根本转变
B: 国民党在农村调整扶助农工政策

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Mao Zedong said in an article: "Down with imperialism, down with the military, down with corrupt officials, down with local tyrants, these political slogans have really disappeared, flying to the front of countless young people, middle-aged people, old men, children and women in the countryside, and have penetrated into their brains, and flowed from their brains to their mouths." The phenomenon described in the article shows that 
A. The nature of the Chinese revolution began to undergo a fundamental change 
B. The Kuomintang adjusted its policy of supporting farmers and workers in rural areas 
C. The goals of the Chinese revolution are consistent with the needs of the people 
D. The CCP's theory of armed separatist regimes of workers and peasants is becoming increasingly mature

Question: 汉武帝时，朝廷制作出许多一尺见方的白鹿皮，称为“皮币”，定价为40万钱一张。诸侯王参加献礼时，必须购皮币用来置放礼物，而当时一个“千户侯”一年的租税收入约为20万钱。朝廷这种做法
A: 加强了货币管理
B: 实现了对地方的控制
C: 削弱了诸侯实力
D: 确立了思想上的统一
options:
A. 加强了货币管理
B. 实现了对地方的控制
C. 削弱了诸侯实力
D. 确立了思想上的统一
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
汉武帝时，朝廷制作出许多一尺见方的白鹿皮，称为“皮币”，定价为40万钱一张。诸侯王参加献礼时，必须购皮币用来置放礼物，而当时一个“千户侯”一年的租税收入约为20万钱。朝廷这种做法

en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the reign of Emperor Wu of Han, the court produced many white deer skins of one foot square, called "skin coins", and priced at 400,000 coins per piece. When the princes participated in the tribute, they had to buy skin coins to place the gifts. At that time, the annual tax income of a "thousand-household marquis" was about 200,000 coins. The court's practice
A. Strengthened currency management
B. Achieved control over the local areas
C. Weakened the power of the princes
D. Established ideological unity

Question: 秦朝法律规定，私拿养子财物以偷盗罪论处，私拿亲子财物无罪；西晋时规定，私拿养子财物同样无罪。这一变化表明，西晋时
A: 儒家伦理得到强化
B: 宗族利益受到保护
C: 养子亲子权利相同
D: 血缘亲情逐渐淡化

B. 宗族利益受到保护

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The Qin Dynasty law stipulated that taking the property of an adopted son privately was considered theft, but taking the property of one's own son privately was not a crime; the Western Jin Dynasty stipulated that taking the property of an adopted son privately was also not a crime. This change shows that during the Western Jin Dynasty
A. Confucian ethics were strengthened
B. Clan interests were protected
C. Adopted sons and parent sons had the same rights
D. Blood ties gradually faded

Question: 台湾版教材有这样的表述：《道德经》认为文明是人类痛苦和罪恶的源泉。人类的智慧越高，知识越丰富，则痛苦和罪恶也就越大。下列哪一思想家的观点与其截然相悖
A: 泰勒斯
B: 亚里士多德
C: 普岁塔哥拉
D: 苏格拉底
options:
A. 泰勒斯
B. 亚里士多德
C. 普岁塔哥拉
D. 苏格拉底

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
台湾版教材有这样的表述：《道德经》认为文明是人类痛苦和罪恶的源泉。人类的智慧越高，知识越丰富，则痛苦和罪恶也就越大。下列哪一思想家的观点与其截然相悖

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The Taiwan version of the textbook has this statement: The Tao Te Ching believes that civilization is the source of human suffering and sin. The higher the wisdom of mankind and the richer the knowledge, the greater the suffering and sin. Which of the following thinkers has a completely different view?
A. Thales
B. Aristotle
C. Psytagoras
D. Socrates

Question: 清初地理学家刘献廷在其《广阳杂记》中说：“天下有四聚，北则京师，南则佛山，东则苏州，西则汉口，然东海之滨，苏州而外，更有芜湖、扬州、江宁、杭州以分其势，西则惟汉口耳。”据此可知清初
A: 已形成统一国内市场
B: 苏州是江南经济中心
C: 工商业市镇繁荣发展
D: 区域经济发展不平衡
options:
A. 已形成统一国内市场
B. 苏州是江南经济中心
C. 工商业市镇繁荣发展
D. 区域经济发展不平衡
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
清初地理学家刘献廷在其《广阳杂记》中说：“天下有四聚，北则京师，南则佛山，东则苏州，西则汉口，然东海之滨，苏州而外，更有芜湖、扬州、江宁、杭州以分其势，西则惟汉口耳。”据此可知清初
A. 已形成统一国内市场
B. 苏州是江南经济中心
C. 工商业市镇繁荣发展
D. 区域经济发展不平衡
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Liu Xianting, a geographer in the early Qing Dynasty, said in his "Miscellaneous Notes of Guangyang": "There are four places in the world, the capital in the north, Foshan in the south, Suzhou in the east, and Hankou in the west. However, on the coast of the East China Sea, in addition to Suzhou, there are Wuhu, Yangzhou, Jiangning, and Hangzhou to divide its power. In the west, there is only Hankou." Based on this, we can know that in the early Qing Dynasty
A. A unified domestic market had been formed
B. Suzhou was the economic center of Jiangnan
C. Industrial and commercial towns prospered and developed
D. Regional economic development was unbalanced

Question: “吾国纱厂事业，自欧战起后，获利甚厚，国人鉴于利之所在，均争相投资，设厂增锭，大有风起云涌之势。迨欧战告终，本纱之输出杜绝，外纱复纷至沓来，遂致连年市价，一蹶不振”。据此判断，第一次世界大战后中国棉纺织业“一蹶不振”的原因有：a世界棉纺织业渐趋萎缩；b西方列强经济侵略；c官僚资本挤压民族企业；d商人投资规模过度
A: ac
B: ad
C: bd
D: bc
options:
A. ac
B. ad
C. bd
D. bc
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
“吾国纱厂事业，自欧战起后，获利甚厚，国人鉴于利之所在，均争相投资，设厂增锭，大有风起云涌之势。迨欧战告终，本纱之输出杜绝，外纱复纷至沓来，遂致连年市价，一蹶不振”。据此判断，第一次世界大战后中国棉纺织业“一蹶不振”的原因有：a世界棉纺织业渐趋萎缩；b西方列强经济侵略；c官僚资本挤压民族企业；d商人投资规模过度
A. ac
B. ad
C. bd
D. bc
en:
The next question is about China's history.
"Since the outbreak of the European war, the cotton mill industry in our country has made great profits. In view of the profits, the Chinese people have rushed to invest, set up factories and increase spindles, and the situation has been surging. When the European war ended, the export of domestic yarn was stopped, and foreign yarns began to pour in, causing the market price to fall for many years." Based on this, the reasons for the "fall" of China's cotton textile industry after the First World War are: a. The world cotton textile industry gradually shrank; b. Economic aggression by Western powers; c. Bureaucratic capital squeezed national enterprises; d. Excessive investment by businessmen
A. ac
B. ad
C. bd
D. bc

Question: 宋明理学普遍倡导“存理去欲”的修养论，“格物”的认识论，“成贤成圣”的境界论，“齐家平天下”的功名论，其根本出发点是
A: 培养经世致用的人才
B: 树立理学的统治地位
C: 修身养性，提高个人修养
D: 规范社会秩序，实现社会和谐
options:
A. 培养经世致用的人才
B. 树立理学的统治地位
C. 修身养性，提高个人修养
D. 规范社会秩序，实现社会和谐
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
宋明理学普遍倡导“存理去欲”的修养论，“格物”的认识论，“成贤成圣”的境界论，“齐家平天下”的功名论，其根本出发点是
A. 培养经世致用的人才
B. 树立理学的统治地位
C. 修身养性，提高个人修养
D. 规范社会秩序，实现社会和谐
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Neo-Confucianism in the Song and Ming dynasties generally advocated the theory of self-cultivation of "keeping principles and eliminating desires", the theory of knowledge of "investigating things", the theory of realm of "becoming a sage", and the theory of fame of "regulating the family and pacifying the world". Its fundamental starting point is
A. To cultivate talents who can be useful in the world
B. To establish the dominant position of Neo-Confucianism
C. To cultivate oneself and improve personal cultivation
D. To regulate social order and achieve social harmony

Question: 20世纪30年代中期，《新中华》载文：“现在你随便拉住一个稍稍留心中国经济问题的人，问他中国经济性质如何，他就毫不犹豫地答复你：中国经济是半殖民地性半封建性经济。”这可以用来说明当时
A: 经济理论问题引起民众的普遍关注
B: 知识界对中国社会性质的认识相同
C: 马克思主义思想方法得到传播
D: 官僚资本主义在中国迅速膨胀
options:
A. 经济理论问题引起民众的普遍关注
B. 知识界对中国社会性质的认识相同
C. 马克思主义思想方法得到传播
D. 官僚资本主义在中国迅速膨胀
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
20世纪30年代中期，《新中华》载文：“现在你随便拉住一个稍稍留心中国经济问题的人，问他中国经济性质如何，他就毫不犹豫地答复你：中国经济是半殖民地性半封建性经济。”这可以用来说明当时

C. 马克思主义思想方法得到传播
D. 官僚资本主义在中国迅速膨胀
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the mid-1930s, New China published an article: "Now if you grab anyone who pays a little attention to China's economic issues and ask him what the nature of China's economy is, he will answer you without hesitation: China's economy is semi-colonial and semi-feudal." This can be used to illustrate that at that time
A. Economic theory issues attracted widespread attention from the public
B. The intellectual community had the same understanding of the nature of Chinese society
C. Marxist thought methods were spread
D. Bureaucratic capitalism expanded rapidly in China

Question: 《说文解字·序》载：“秦书有八体，一曰大篆，二曰小篆，……八曰隶书”。《汉书·艺文志》亦载：“是时始建隶书矣，起于官狱多事，苟趋省易，施之于徒隶也。”以上材料反映了
A: 隶书是在楷书基础上发展而来
B: 隶书是汉代狱官为书写方便而创
C: 隶书是秦代八大篆书字体之一
D: 隶书的创建与抄录公文狱事有关
options:
A. 隶书是在楷书基础上发展而来
B. 隶书是汉代狱官为书写方便而创
C. 隶书是秦代八大篆书字体之一
D. 隶书的创建与抄录公文狱事有关
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《说文解字·序》载：“秦书有八体，一曰大篆，二曰小篆，……八曰隶书”。《汉书·艺文志》亦载：“是时始建隶书矣，起于官狱多事，苟趋省易，施之于徒隶也。”以上材料反映了
A. 隶书是在楷书基础上发展而来
B. 隶书是汉代狱官为书写方便而创

D. 隶书的创建与抄录公文狱事有关
en:
The next question is about China's history.
"Shuowen Jiezi·Xu" states: "There are eight styles of Qin script, one is Dazhuan, the second is Xiaozhuan, and the eighth is Lishu". "Han Shu·Yiwenzhi" also states: "Lishu was first established at that time. It originated from the fact that officials and prisons were busy, and they wanted to simplify things, so they applied it to prisoners." The above materials reflect
A. Lishu was developed on the basis of Kaishu
B. Lishu was created by prison officials in the Han Dynasty for the convenience of writing
C. Lishu is one of the eight major seal scripts in the Qin Dynasty
D. The creation of Lishu is related to copying official documents and prison affairs

Question: 从秦至清的两千多年中，许多皇帝或由于年幼庸弱，或由于当时形势和力量对比的变化，因而受制于母后、外戚、宦官、权臣、地方割据势力等，导致权力的萎缩或丧失。这种现象实质上是
A: 君权至上的后果
B: 君主专制被颠覆
C: 中央集权体制遭到破坏
D: 君主权力受到制约
options:
A. 君权至上的后果
B. 君主专制被颠覆
C. 中央集权体制遭到破坏
D. 君主权力受到制约
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
从秦至清的两千多年中，许多皇帝或由于年幼庸弱，或由于当时形势和力量对比的变化，因而受制于母后、外戚、宦官、权臣、地方割据势力等，导致权力的萎缩或丧失。这种现象实质上是
A. 君权至上的后果
B. 君主专制被颠覆
C. 中央集权体制遭到破坏
D. 君主权力受到制约
en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the two thousand years from the Qin Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty, many emperors were restrained by their mothers, relatives, eunuchs, powerful officials, local separatist forces, etc., either because they were young and weak or because of changes in the situation and balance of power at the time, which led to the shrinkage or loss of power. This phenomenon is essentially
A. The consequence of the supremacy of the monarchy
B. The subversion of the monarchy
C. The destruction of the centralized system
D. The monarchy is restricted

Question: 孟子发扬孔子开创的儒学，主张涵养“浩然之气”，倡导“富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈”，对后世影响极大。孟子这些言论所强调的是
A: 敢于反抗专制暴政
B: 勇于突破礼制束缚
C: 努力完善个人品德
D: 坚持个人独特性格
options:
A. 敢于反抗专制暴政
B. 勇于突破礼制束缚
C. 努力完善个人品德
D. 坚持个人独特性格
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
孟子发扬孔子开创的儒学，主张涵养“浩然之气”，倡导“富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈”，对后世影响极大。孟子这些言论所强调的是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Mencius carried forward the Confucianism founded by Confucius, advocated the cultivation of "great spirit", and advocated "wealth and honor cannot corrupt, poverty and humbleness cannot move, and power and force cannot bend", which had a great influence on later generations. Mencius's remarks emphasize
A. Dare to resist autocratic tyranny
B. Courage to break through the constraints of etiquette
C. Strive to improve personal morality
D. Adhere to personal unique character

Question: 1989年以来，中国先后参加了22项维和行动，累计派出维和官兵20000多人次，其中，有3名军事观察员和6名维和士兵在执行任务时英勇牺牲。这说明当前我国
A: 积极参加以联合国为中心的多边外交
B: 积极参与制定国际政治经济秩序规则
C: 建立新型区域合作组织
D: 已成为世界政治格局多极化中的一极
options:
A. 积极参加以联合国为中心的多边外交
B. 积极参与制定国际政治经济秩序规则

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Since 1989, China has participated in 22 peacekeeping operations and sent more than 20,000 peacekeepers, of which 3 military observers and 6 peacekeepers died heroically while performing their duties. This shows that my country is currently
A. actively participating in multilateral diplomacy centered on the United Nations

The next question is about China's history.

A. New Democratic State
B. Capitalist State

Question: 20世纪80年代，农村改革的突破性进展推动了城市经济体制改革。学者敏锐地看到“公社体制改革后，农工分了手，农业经营承包到户”；企业家感慨“现在不同了，我得考虑如何增强企业活力”。这表明：a人民公社体制逐步废除 b企业生产经营自主权扩大c现代企业制度开始试点 d非公有制经济开始起主导作用

B: ab
C: bc
D: bd
options:

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
20世纪80年代，农村改革的突破性进展推动了城市经济体制改革。学者敏锐地看到“公社体制改革后，农工分了手，农业经营承包到户”；企业家感慨“现在不同了，我得考虑如何增强企业活力”。这表明：a人民公社体制逐步废除 b企业生产经营自主权扩大c现代企业制度开始试点 d非公有制经济开始起主导作用

B. ab
C. bc
D. bd
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the 1980s, the breakthrough progress of rural reform promoted the reform of the urban economic system. Scholars keenly observed that "after the reform of the commune system, farmers and workers were separated, and agricultural operations were contracted to households"; entrepreneurs lamented that "now it is different, I have to consider how to enhance the vitality of the enterprise." This shows that: a The people's commune system was gradually abolished b The production and operation autonomy of enterprises was expanded c The modern enterprise system began to be piloted d The non-public economy began to play a leading role
A. ac
B. ab
C. bc
D. bd

A: 描述者肯定报纸的教化功能

There are newspapers everywhere, but there is no "Central" but "Datong" ("Central" and "Datong" were the names of newspapers at that time)." This description shows that
A. The author of the description affirms the educational function of newspapers
B. Newspaper opinion is controlled by the authoritarian government
C. Newspaper propaganda has become the fundamental driving force of reform
D. The author of the description advocates the diversification of the newspaper industry

Commentators believe that "Encouraging Learning"
A. advocates abandoning Confucius in order for China to awaken
B. is a complete negation of traditional culture
C. points out China's future path
D. conforms to the trend of the times

Question: 程颢诗云：“闲来无事不从容，睡觉东窗日已红。万物静观皆自得，四时佳兴与人同。道通天地有形外，思入风云变态中。富贵不淫贫贱乐，男儿到此是豪雄。”其体现的主旨是
A: 张扬自我的人生态度
B: 人类与自然和谐共处
C: 人与万事万物皆同理
D: 无为而治的思想理念

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Cheng Hao's poem says: "I am not at ease when I have nothing to do. When I sleep, the sun is already red in the east window. I am content with everything I observe quietly, and I share the joy of the four seasons with others. The Tao is beyond the physical world, and the thoughts are in the changing wind and clouds. A man is not corrupted by wealth and is happy in poverty. A man who reaches this point is a hero." The main theme is 
A. A life attitude that promotes self-expression
B. Harmonious coexistence between humans and nature
C. The same principles apply to humans and everything
D. The idea of governing by doing nothing

Question: 北宋实行募兵制，兵士待遇较为优厚，应募者以此养家糊口，兵员最多时达120多万人。这一制度

A: 君主寿命的时代差异
B: 血缘纽带关系的弱化

B. The weakening of blood ties
C. The change in the way the throne is inherited
D. The long-term impact of the abdication system

Question: 某教授认为：元朝行省制中央集权是秦汉以来郡县制中央集权模式的较高级演化形态，也是两宋否定唐后期藩镇分权的继续，相当于自隋朝始第三个“正一反一合”阶段的“合”。作者认为

B: 兼具改良与革命的色彩

A. 御史制度促进了国家行政的运行
B. 郡县制度推动了中央集权加强
C. 三公九卿制度设计得比较合理
D. 皇帝制度保证了行政的有效运作
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
秦统一后，为了巩固封建统治，“建立了一套比较完备的、系统的国家管理机构——金字塔式的中枢行政系统……采用分工的原则，使中央政府能维持有效的运作，以管理庞大的帝国”。材料说明
A. 御史制度促进了国家行政的运行
B. 郡县制度推动了中央集权加强
C. 三公九卿制度设计得比较合理
D. 皇帝制度保证了行政的有效运作
en:
The next question is about China's history.
After the Qin Dynasty unified China, in order to consolidate its feudal rule, it "established a relatively complete and systematic national administrative institution - a pyramid-shaped central administrative system... The principle of division of labor was adopted to enable the central government to maintain effective operation to manage the vast empire." Material description
A. The censor system promoted the operation of national administration
B. The county system promoted the strengthening of central power
C. The three dukes and nine ministers system was designed relatively reasonably
D. The emperor system ensured the effective operation of administration

Question: 1926年，有报纸评论说：“自从蒋介石抬出三民主义，大出风头以后，许多人都觉得主义是值钱的，于是乎孙传芳标榜三爱(爱国、爱民、爱敌)，东三省有人主张三权(民权、国权、人权)。听说四川有些军人到处请教人替他们想个主义玩玩。”这种现象反映了当时
A: 各地军阀对三民主义理解存在差异
B: 民主思想已经成为社会潮流
C: 标榜主义成为军阀自保的主要手段
D: 政治宣传促使各界思想趋同
options:
A. 各地军阀对三民主义理解存在差异
B. 民主思想已经成为社会潮流
C. 标榜主义成为军阀自保的主要手段
D. 政治宣传促使各界思想趋同
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1926年，有报纸评论说：“自从蒋介石抬出三民主义，大出风头以后，许多人都觉得主义是值钱的，于是乎孙传芳标榜三爱(爱国、爱民、爱敌)，东三省有人主张三权(民权、国权、人权)。听说四川有些军人到处请教人替他们想个主义玩玩。”这种现象反映了当时
A. 各地军阀对三民主义理解存在差异

C. 标榜主义成为军阀自保的主要手段
D. 政治宣传促使各界思想趋同
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1926, a newspaper commented: "Since Chiang Kai-shek brought up the Three Principles of the People and became famous, many people think that doctrines are valuable. So Sun Chuanfang advocated the Three Loves (love for the country, love for the people, love for the enemy), and some people in the three northeastern provinces advocated the Three Rights (civil rights, national rights, and human rights). I heard that some soldiers in Sichuan asked people to come up with an doctrine for them to play with." This phenomenon reflects that at that time
A. Warlords in various places had different understandings of the Three Principles of the People
B. Democratic ideas had become a social trend
C. Advocating doctrines became the main means for warlords to protect themselves
D. Political propaganda promoted the convergence of ideas among all walks of life

Question: 当某条约的若干条款传出后，光绪皇帝发出“台湾割则天下人心皆去，朕何以为天下主!”的哀叹，台籍京官及举人纷纷声言“与其生为降虏，不如死为义民!”该条约应是
A: 《天津条约》
B: 《南京条约》
C: 《北京条约》
D: 《马关条约》
options:
A. 《天津条约》
B. 《南京条约》
C. 《北京条约》
D. 《马关条约》
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
当某条约的若干条款传出后，光绪皇帝发出“台湾割则天下人心皆去，朕何以为天下主!”的哀叹，台籍京官及举人纷纷声言“与其生为降虏，不如死为义民!”该条约应是
A. 《天津条约》
B. 《南京条约》
C. 《北京条约》
D. 《马关条约》
en:
The next question is about China's history.
When some clauses of a treaty were announced, Emperor Guangxu lamented, "If Taiwan is ceded, the hearts of the people in the world will leave. How can I rule the world?" Taiwanese officials and scholars in Beijing declared, "It is better to die as a righteous citizen than to live as a captive!" The treaty should be
A. "Tianjin Treaty"
B. "Nanjing Treaty"
C. "Beijing Treaty"
D. "Shimonoseki Treaty"

Question: 1897年10月，严复等人在天津创办《国闻报》，一方面选择百余种外国报刊作为稿件来源，另一方面还派员到各地采访，国内偏重于北方各省，国外则设访员于伦敦、学.科网巴黎、柏林、彼得堡、纽约、华盛顿等处。这表明
A: 国内无报刊供其选稿
B: 维新思想的传播仅限于北方各省
C: 清政府允许自由办报
D: 维新派要让读者了解国内外大事
options:
A. 国内无报刊供其选稿
B. 维新思想的传播仅限于北方各省
C. 清政府允许自由办报
D. 维新派要让读者了解国内外大事
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1897年10月，严复等人在天津创办《国闻报》，一方面选择百余种外国报刊作为稿件来源，另一方面还派员到各地采访，国内偏重于北方各省，国外则设访员于伦敦、学.科网巴黎、柏林、彼得堡、纽约、华盛顿等处。这表明
A. 国内无报刊供其选稿
B. 维新思想的传播仅限于北方各省
C. 清政府允许自由办报
D. 维新派要让读者了解国内外大事
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In October 1897, Yan Fu and others founded Guo Wen Bao in Tianjin. On the one hand, they selected more than 100 foreign newspapers and periodicals as sources of manuscripts, and on the other hand, they sent staff to various places for interviews. Domestically, they focused on the northern provinces, and overseas, they set up interviewers in London, Paris, Berlin, St. Petersburg, New York, Washington, etc. This shows that
A. There were no newspapers and periodicals in China for them to select manuscripts
B. The spread of reformist ideas was limited to the northern provinces
C. The Qing government allowed free newspaper publishing
D. The reformists wanted readers to understand major domestic and international events

Question: 西汉初年，刘邦封置诸侯王国．封子弟为王。功臣为侯，并规定“非刘氏不王．非有功不侯”。这表明刘邦推行分封制意在
A: 确保皇位传承稳固
B: 加强对地方的控制
C: 继承西周的政治体制
D: 否定秦朝的政治体制
options:
A. 确保皇位传承稳固
B. 加强对地方的控制
C. 继承西周的政治体制
D. 否定秦朝的政治体制
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
西汉初年，刘邦封置诸侯王国．封子弟为王。功臣为侯，并规定“非刘氏不王．非有功不侯”。这表明刘邦推行分封制意在

B. 加强对地方的控制
C. 继承西周的政治体制
D. 否定秦朝的政治体制
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early years of the Western Han Dynasty, Liu Bang established feudal kingdoms. He made his sons kings. He made meritorious officials marquises, and stipulated that "only the Liu family can be kings, and only meritorious officials can be marquises." This shows that Liu Bang's implementation of the feudal system was intended to
A. Ensure the stability of the throne
B. Strengthen control over the local areas
C. Inherit the political system of the Western Zhou Dynasty
D. Negate the political system of the Qin Dynasty

Question: 中国传统家族有“长兄如父”“小儿不及长孙”的说法。这些说法体现的是
A: 贵族世袭
B: 等级秩序
C: 家族和睦
D: 宗法观念
options:
A. 贵族世袭

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
中国传统家族有“长兄如父”“小儿不及长孙”的说法。这些说法体现的是
A. 贵族世袭

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In traditional Chinese families, there are sayings such as "eldest brother is like father" and "younger son is not as good as eldest grandson". These sayings reflect
A. hereditary nobility
B. hierarchical order
C. family harmony
D. clan concept

Question: 南京参议院选举袁世凯为临时大总统后，资产阶级革命派的大多数人认为“袁世凯尽管不好，我们希望他好，要用诚恳的劝告，严密的监视，感动他，鼓励他，使他不能不好。”为此，资产阶级革命派
A: 颁布《中华民国临时约法》
B: 发起新文化运动
C: 成立同盟会
D: 发动护法运动
options:

B. 发起新文化运动

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
南京参议院选举袁世凯为临时大总统后，资产阶级革命派的大多数人认为“袁世凯尽管不好，我们希望他好，要用诚恳的劝告，严密的监视，感动他，鼓励他，使他不能不好。”为此，资产阶级革命派
A. 颁布《中华民国临时约法》
B. 发起新文化运动
C. 成立同盟会
D. 发动护法运动
en:
The next question is about China's history.
After the Nanjing Senate elected Yuan Shikai as the provisional president, most of the bourgeois revolutionaries believed that "even though Yuan Shikai is not good, we hope he will be good. We should use sincere advice and strict surveillance to move him, encourage him, and make him not bad." For this reason, the bourgeois revolutionaries
A. promulgated the "Provisional Constitution of the Republic of China"
B. launched the New Culture Movement
C. established the Tongmenghui
D. launched the Protection of Law Movement

Question: 陈东升在《大国崛起的中国模式》中说：1979年以来，中国的发展可谓占尽“天时、地利、人和”。下列属于他所说的“天时”的是：a 召开十一届三中全会，确定改革开放的伟大决策；b 和平与发展成为时代主题；c 邓小平提出建设有中国特色的社会主义理论；d 第三次科技革命的兴起和扩展
A: bd
B: ac
C: abd
D: abcd
options:
A. bd
B. ac
C. abd
D. abcd
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
陈东升在《大国崛起的中国模式》中说：1979年以来，中国的发展可谓占尽“天时、地利、人和”。下列属于他所说的“天时”的是：a 召开十一届三中全会，确定改革开放的伟大决策；b 和平与发展成为时代主题；c 邓小平提出建设有中国特色的社会主义理论；d 第三次科技革命的兴起和扩展
A. bd
B. ac
C. abd
D. abcd
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Chen Dongsheng said in "The Chinese Model of the Rise of a Great Power": Since 1979, China's development has been "at the right time, at the right place, and with the right people". The following are the "right time" he mentioned: a The Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee was held to determine the great decision of reform and opening up; b Peace and development became the theme of the times; c Deng Xiaoping proposed the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics; d The rise and expansion of the third scientific and technological revolution
A. bd
B. ac
C. abd
D. abcd

Question: 王莽建立新朝取代西汉，仅遭到朝野人士的零星反对；东汉末年既有割据一方的豪强，更有权势滔天的权臣，却大都不敢称帝。东汉末年这一现象出现的原因是
A: 权臣豪强对中央集权的畏惧
B: 儒学忠君思想进一步理论化
C: 当时社会对君权神授的尊崇
D: 儒家“经世致用”思想的恢复
options:
A. 权臣豪强对中央集权的畏惧
B. 儒学忠君思想进一步理论化
C. 当时社会对君权神授的尊崇
D. 儒家“经世致用”思想的恢复
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
王莽建立新朝取代西汉，仅遭到朝野人士的零星反对；东汉末年既有割据一方的豪强，更有权势滔天的权臣，却大都不敢称帝。东汉末年这一现象出现的原因是
A. 权臣豪强对中央集权的畏惧
B. 儒学忠君思想进一步理论化
C. 当时社会对君权神授的尊崇
D. 儒家“经世致用”思想的恢复
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Wang Mang established the Xin Dynasty to replace the Western Han Dynasty, but encountered only sporadic opposition from people in and out of the court; at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, there were both powerful tyrants and powerful ministers, but most of them did not dare to claim the throne. The reason for this phenomenon at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty was
A. The fear of the centralization of power by powerful ministers
B. The further theoreticalization of Confucianism's loyalty to the emperor
C. The respect for the divine right of the emperor in society at that time
D. The restoration of the Confucian idea of "practicing what you do"

Question: 杨奎松在《中华人民共和国建国史研究（2）》中曾这样评价新中国的外交政策：“这是新中国外交政策从突出强调意识形态的“一边倒”，转向较多地考虑国家现实利益而开始走向务实的相当重要的标志。”该观点依据的史实应该是
A: “打扫干净屋子再请客”政策的提出
B: 参加日内瓦会议
C: 和平共处五项原则的提出
D: “求同存异”方针的提出
options:
A. “打扫干净屋子再请客”政策的提出
B. 参加日内瓦会议
C. 和平共处五项原则的提出
D. “求同存异”方针的提出
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
杨奎松在《中华人民共和国建国史研究（2）》中曾这样评价新中国的外交政策：“这是新中国外交政策从突出强调意识形态的“一边倒”，转向较多地考虑国家现实利益而开始走向务实的相当重要的标志。”该观点依据的史实应该是

C. 和平共处五项原则的提出
D. “求同存异”方针的提出
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Yang Kuisong commented on the foreign policy of New China in his book Research on the History of the Founding of the People's Republic of China (2): "This is a very important sign that the foreign policy of New China has shifted from emphasizing the "one-sidedness" of ideology to considering the country's actual interests and starting to be pragmatic." The historical facts on which this view is based should be 
A. The proposal of the "clean up the house before inviting guests" policy 
B. Participation in the Geneva Conference 
C. The proposal of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence 
D. The proposal of the "seek common ground while reserving differences" policy

Question: 读甲午战争后中国官办和商办企业情况表。据此表可知，1895-1913年间，民营企业
A: 办厂规模逐渐超过官办企业
B: 面临的发展阻力在逐渐减小
C: 成为当时近代化的主导力量
D: 仍没有摆脱官办企业的束缚
options:
A. 办厂规模逐渐超过官办企业
B. 面临的发展阻力在逐渐减小
C. 成为当时近代化的主导力量
D. 仍没有摆脱官办企业的束缚
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
读甲午战争后中国官办和商办企业情况表。据此表可知，1895-1913年间，民营企业

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Read the table of Chinese government-run and private enterprises after the Sino-Japanese War. According to this table, between 1895 and 1913, private enterprises
A. gradually exceeded government-run enterprises in terms of scale
B. faced less and less resistance to development
C. became the leading force in modernization at that time
D. still did not get rid of the constraints of government-run enterprises

Question: 周代青铜器上的铭文与商代相比，字数越来越多，语句也愈加格式化。这些铭文大都记述个人业绩，追颂祖先功德，希冀子孙保用。这表明西周时
A: 未能充分发挥文书功能
B: 形成了重视历史传承的风尚
C: 青铜器的功用发生重大历史改变
D: 创造了一种全新的文字体系
options:
A. 未能充分发挥文书功能
B. 形成了重视历史传承的风尚
C. 青铜器的功用发生重大历史改变
D. 创造了一种全新的文字体系
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
周代青铜器上的铭文与商代相比，字数越来越多，语句也愈加格式化。这些铭文大都记述个人业绩，追颂祖先功德，希冀子孙保用。这表明西周时
A. 未能充分发挥文书功能
B. 形成了重视历史传承的风尚
C. 青铜器的功用发生重大历史改变

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Compared with the Shang Dynasty, the inscriptions on bronze ware in the Zhou Dynasty had more characters and more formatted sentences. Most of these inscriptions recorded personal achievements, praised the merits of ancestors, and hoped that their descendants would keep them. This shows that in the Western Zhou Dynasty
A. the function of documents was not fully utilized
B. a trend of attaching importance to historical inheritance was formed
C. the function of bronze ware underwent a major historical change
D. a new writing system was created

Question: 公元前1046年，武王率兵在牧野打败商军，建立周朝。这一年处在
A: 公元前10世纪下半叶
B: 公元前l1世纪下半叶
C: 公元前11世纪上半叶
D: 公元前10世纪上半叶
options:
A. 公元前10世纪下半叶
B. 公元前l1世纪下半叶

zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
公元前1046年，武王率兵在牧野打败商军，建立周朝。这一年处在

B. 公元前l1世纪下半叶

The next question is about China's history.
In 1046 BC, King Wu led his army to defeat the Shang army in Muye and established the Zhou Dynasty. This year was in
A. the second half of the 10th century BC
B. the second half of the 11th century BC
C. the first half of the 11th century BC
D. the first half of the 10th century BC

Question: 1946年，国民党不断进犯各解放区，但在口头上仍说遵守《双十协定》，双方在南京进行谈判。谈判破裂后，国民党对中共人员限期撤离，中共与美方紧急磋商，美国同意麦康内尔执行“鲶鱼行动”，把中共人员安全送回到了延安。材料表明
A: 国共关系引起美国高度关注
B: 中共在内战中处于弱势地位
C: 中共赢得了美国的舆论支持
D: 美国改变了对国民党的支持
options:
A. 国共关系引起美国高度关注
B. 中共在内战中处于弱势地位
C. 中共赢得了美国的舆论支持
D. 美国改变了对国民党的支持
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1946年，国民党不断进犯各解放区，但在口头上仍说遵守《双十协定》，双方在南京进行谈判。谈判破裂后，国民党对中共人员限期撤离，中共与美方紧急磋商，美国同意麦康内尔执行“鲶鱼行动”，把中共人员安全送回到了延安。材料表明
A. 国共关系引起美国高度关注
B. 中共在内战中处于弱势地位
C. 中共赢得了美国的舆论支持
D. 美国改变了对国民党的支持
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1946, the KMT continued to invade the liberated areas, but verbally still said that it would abide by the Double Tenth Agreement. The two sides negotiated in Nanjing. After the negotiations broke down, the KMT set a deadline for the CCP personnel to evacuate. The CCP and the US held emergency consultations, and the US agreed to McConnell's "Catfish Operation" to safely send the CCP personnel back to Yan'an. The materials show that 
A. The relationship between the KMT and the CPC attracted great attention from the United States 
B. The CCP was in a weak position in the civil war 
C. The CCP won the support of American public opinion 
D. The United States changed its support for the KMT

Question: 1928年的《长寿县志》载：村落农民祠祭“拜跪无节，衣冠不肃，等于儿戏，甚者祠堂有款不妨虚糜，强者借以自肥，黠者分其余润，愚懦者每年幸叨一饱，已无他望。”这一现象主要反映了
A: 乡村传统文化渐趋失落
B: 民主革命进程影响乡村习俗

A. 乡村传统文化渐趋失落

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The 1928 "Changshou County Chronicles" states that the village peasants "knelt and worshipped without restraint, dressed in a frivolous manner, and even squandered the money in the ancestral halls. The strong used it to enrich themselves, the cunning shared the rest, and the foolish and cowardly were lucky to have a full meal every year and had no other hope." This phenomenon mainly reflects
A. The gradual loss of rural traditional culture
B. The democratic revolution process affected rural customs
C. The rural people's thoughts began to be liberated
D. The coexistence of the old and the new in modern social life

The next question is about China's history.
"According to this theory, it is meaningless to say that time and space are absolute, because measurements of these two categories usually change with the movement of the observer. ... To the layman, these views - usually explained by incomprehensible mathematical formulas - show that science has reached the limit of what can be known by humans. The main significance of the above "theory" is 
A. It pioneered modern science based on experiments 
B. It made up for the shortcomings of classical mechanics in understanding time and space 
C. It discovered the motion principle of energy radiation 
D. The accuracy of predicting the existence of Neptune

B: 有田者无力可耕

A. 小农户个体经营

en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to ancient historians, in the rural society south of the Yangtze River, "every family has enough food, they have a room to live in, they have a field to rent, they have a mountain to burn firewood, they have a garden to cultivate... Marriage is on time, the neighborhood is peaceful, women spin and weave, men grow mulberry and weave, and the neighbors are harmonious." The agricultural economic situation reflected in this material is
A. Individual farming by small farmers
B. Those who have land have no money to farm
C. Land rights are consistent with laborers
D. Excessive land concentration

Question: 推开斑驳厚重的历史大门，翻检汗牛充栋的文化典籍，我们触摸着五千年中华文明的脉搏。其中有这么一部典籍，文字精练，人物刻画与叙事生动，不虚美，不隐恶，是一部兼具史学和文学特色的不朽名著，被誉为“史家之绝唱，无韵之离骚”。该典籍是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Pushing open the mottled and heavy door of history, and checking the numerous cultural classics, we feel the pulse of 5,000 years of Chinese civilization. Among them, there is such a classic, with concise text, vivid character portrayal and narrative, no false praise, no concealment of evil, it is an immortal masterpiece with both historical and literary characteristics, and is praised as "the swan song of historians, the Li Sao without rhyme". The classic is
A. "Book of Han"
B. "Spring and Autumn"
C. "Zizhi Tongjian"
D. "Records of the Grand Historian"

Question: 周恩来曾回忆说：“讲到中国革命的性质，今天似乎是老生常谈了……可是在六大(1928年)时，这却是个很严重的问题……当时无论从莫斯科中山大学或从西欧回来的同志又都轻视理论，所以对革命的性质问题都搞不清。”这表明大革命时期中国共产党
A: 正确认识到农村根据地的地位
B: 受到共产国际的强烈影响
C: 已逐渐克服教条主义倾向
D: 尚未确立明确的革命目标
options:
A. 正确认识到农村根据地的地位
B. 受到共产国际的强烈影响
C. 已逐渐克服教条主义倾向
D. 尚未确立明确的革命目标

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Zhou Enlai once recalled: "Speaking of the nature of the Chinese revolution, it seems to be a commonplace today... But at the Sixth National Congress (1928), this was a very serious issue... At that time, comrades who returned from Sun Yat-sen University in Moscow or from Western Europe all despised theory, so they were confused about the nature of the revolution." This shows that during the Great Revolution, the Chinese Communist Party
A. correctly recognized the status of rural bases
B. was strongly influenced by the Communist International
C. had gradually overcome dogmatism
D. had not yet established clear revolutionary goals

Question: 某中学历史兴趣小组试图对“世界史·中国梦”这一主题进行探究，经过查阅资料、分析比较和讨论总结，大家认识到:“中国梦”的本质内涵是实现国家富强、民族复兴、人民幸福和社会和谐，它符合当今世界的时代主题，与人类的进步紧密相连。因此，“中国梦”：a 有别于近代主要西方国家的大国之梦；b 同冷战时期苏联的大国之梦基本一致；c 有助于推动世界格局多极化趋势发展；d 意味着中国对人类的贡献将越来越大
A: abc
B: abd
C: acd
D: bcd
options:
A. abc
B. abd
C. acd
D. bcd

B. abd

D. bcd
en:
The next question is about China's history.
A middle school history interest group tried to explore the theme of "World History·Chinese Dream". After consulting materials, analyzing, comparing and discussing, everyone realized that the essential connotation of the "Chinese Dream" is to achieve national prosperity, national rejuvenation, people's happiness and social harmony. It conforms to the theme of the times in today's world and is closely linked to human progress. Therefore, the "Chinese Dream": a is different from the great power dream of major Western countries in modern times; b is basically the same as the great power dream of the Soviet Union during the Cold War; c is conducive to promoting the development of the multipolarization trend of the world pattern; d means that China's contribution to mankind will become greater and greater
A. abc
B. abd
C. acd
D. bcd

Question: 毛泽东在中共七大上说：“俄国在十月革命胜利以后，还有一个时期让资本主义作为部分经济而存在，而且还是很大的一部分……我们的同志在这方面是太急了。”毛泽东旨在
A: 强调应坚持新民主主义路线
B: 重申农村包围城市的革命道路

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Mao Zedong said at the Seventh National Congress of the Communist Party of China: "After the victory of the October Revolution, Russia still allowed capitalism to exist as part of the economy, and it was a large part... Our comrades were too hasty in this regard." Mao Zedong aimed to
A. emphasize the need to adhere to the New Democratic Line
B. reiterate the revolutionary path of encircling the cities from the countryside
C. explain the urgency of socialist transformation
D. criticize the New Economic Policy as being out of date

Question: 江南农业经济在东晋南朝、唐后期五代及南宋三个时期得到根大发展．其共同的原因是
A: 官府组织民众屯田扩大耕地面积
B: 推广普及铁制农具提高生产效率
C: 黄河流域人口因动乱大规模南迁
D: 政府改革税制调动农民的积极性

The agricultural economy in Jiangnan developed greatly in the Eastern Jin Dynasty, the Southern Dynasties, the late Tang Dynasty, the Five Dynasties, and the Southern Song Dynasty. The common reason is that 
A. The government organized the people to cultivate land to expand the cultivated land area 
B. The popularization of iron farm tools improved production efficiency 
C. The population in the Yellow River Basin migrated south on a large scale due to unrest 
D. The government reformed the tax system to mobilize the enthusiasm of farmers

Question: 有学者认为，《天朝田亩制度》在晚清思想史中具有独特性，显示了传统思想里从未有过的一种组合，即“财产共有与权力全面控制的组合”。在这种思想的“组合”过程中，没有对其产生影响的是
A: 《礼记·礼运》中“大同”思想
B: 农民起义中的“均贫富”思想
C: 基督教平等思想

In the process of "combining" this thought, the following did not have an impact on it:
A. The "Great Harmony" thought in "Book of Rites·Liyun"
B. The "equalization of wealth" thought in the peasant uprising
C. The Christian equality thought
D. The "Chinese learning and Western learning" thought

Question: 据资料统计：在明后期至清前期200余年间，世界白银产量的一半流入中国，拥有一流城市和最为密集、完善的市场网络的中国，成为当时世界经济和贸易的中心区域。然而当时它却没有形成强大的扫荡旧经济基础的革命性变化。其中内在的和人为的原因是
A: 由于鸦片大量流入导致白银的大量外流
B: “重农抑商”和“闭关锁国”的政策的压制
C: 英国工业革命后对中国进行的商品输出
D: 大河流域的农业文明不适于工商业发展

en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to statistics: in the 200 years from the late Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty, half of the world's silver production flowed into China. China, with first-class cities and the most dense and complete market network, became the center of the world's economy and trade at that time. However, it did not form a strong revolutionary change to sweep away the old economic foundation at that time. The internal and man-made reasons are
A. The large outflow of silver due to the large influx of opium
B. The suppression of the policies of "focusing on agriculture and suppressing commerce" and "closing the country to the outside world"

A: 市的交易不再受官府监管
B: 只有州县所在地才许设市
C: 县不满三千户绝不许设市

options:

en:

In the later period, it was stipulated that "if there are more than 3,000 households in a county, one market magistrate and two market officials shall be appointed. If there are less than 3,000 households, no market officials shall be appointed. If important roads need to be set up, and there are old places with heavy transactions, they can be set up according to the 3,000 households rule." From this, we can see that in the late Tang Dynasty
A. Market transactions were no longer supervised by the government
B. Markets were only allowed to be established in prefectures and counties
C. Markets were not allowed to be established in counties with less than 3,000 households
D. The system for establishing markets had been adjusted

Question: 《浅析中西方传统文化的差异与交融》一文指出：“西方文化对中国文化的吸收完全取决于中国文化的魅力和西方文化发展的内在要求。……中国文化在暴力冲撞下被迫吸收西方近代文化，不得不进行痛苦的转型与嬗变。”这说明

The "dignity part" and the "efficiency part" refer to

A. Criticize the harm of rightist errors
B. Learn from the experience of the Russian Revolution

A: 宋太祖不愿史书记录其真实言行
B: 史官与君主间存在尖锐矛盾
C: 宋代史官所撰史书全都真实可信
D: 重史传统影响君主个人行为
options:
A. 宋太祖不愿史书记录其真实言行
B. 史官与君主间存在尖锐矛盾
C. 宋代史官所撰史书全都真实可信
D. 重史传统影响君主个人行为
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
史载，宋太祖某日闷闷不乐，有人问他原因，他说：“尔谓帝王可容易行事耶……偶有误失，史官必书之，我所以不乐也。”此事反映了
A. 宋太祖不愿史书记录其真实言行
B. 史官与君主间存在尖锐矛盾
C. 宋代史官所撰史书全都真实可信
D. 重史传统影响君主个人行为
en:
The next question is about China's history.
According to historical records, Emperor Taizu of Song was unhappy one day. When someone asked him why, he said, "Do you think it's easy for an emperor to act... If there are mistakes, the historians will record them. That's why I'm unhappy." This incident reflects
A. Emperor Taizu of Song did not want history books to record his true words and deeds
B. There was a sharp contradiction between the historians and the monarch
C. All the history books written by historians in the Song Dynasty were true and credible
D. The tradition of attaching importance to history influenced the monarch's personal behavior

Question: 20世纪五六十年代，经济全球化进入新的发展阶段，但有学者认为此时的全球化只是“半球化”，只有到八九十年代的经济全球化浪潮才真正具有全球性。导致“半球化”的主要原因是
A: 南北经济发展的差距
B: 两种经济体制的差异
C: 两极对峙格局的存在
D: 经济区域一体化的发展
options:
A. 南北经济发展的差距
B. 两种经济体制的差异
C. 两极对峙格局的存在
D. 经济区域一体化的发展

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the 1950s and 1960s, economic globalization entered a new stage of development, but some scholars believe that globalization at that time was only "hemisphericization", and it was not until the 1980s and 1990s that the wave of economic globalization became truly global. The main reasons for "hemisphericization" are:
A. The gap in economic development between the north and the south
B. The difference between the two economic systems
C. The existence of a bipolar confrontation pattern
D. The development of economic regional integration

Question: 《无锡道中赋水车》咏颂:“翻翻联联衔尾鸦，荦荦确确蜕骨蛇……天公不念老农泣，唤取阿香推雷车。”这里“水车”的使用
A: 提高了农田抗旱的能力
B: 使农业摆脱自然的束缚
C: 标志着灌溉技术的成熟

A. Improves the drought resistance of farmland
B. Frees agriculture from the constraints of nature
C. Marks the maturity of irrigation technology
D. Opens the precedent of agricultural tool automation

Question: “我旧说以忠孝节义范束全国之人心，一切法度纲纪经数千年圣哲所创垂，竟毫无可贵？何必先自轻贱，一闻新说，遂将数千年所尊信持循者弃绝不值一顾，对于新人物有自惭形秽嗫嚅不敢言之概，甚或迎合新人物毁骂先代遗传，诟辱自家学理。岂国家数百年条教所颁以及吾人胜衣就傅数十年朝斯夕斯者，全属虚伪无物乎”。这种观点没有
A: 说明作者的思想顽固守旧
B: 表达对于新文化运动的不满
C: 会受到当时主流文化的排斥
D: 体现了民族文化的自信心
options:
A. 说明作者的思想顽固守旧
B. 表达对于新文化运动的不满
C. 会受到当时主流文化的排斥
D. 体现了民族文化的自信心

en:
The next question is about China's history.
"My old saying is that loyalty, filial piety, chastity and righteousness are the norms for the people of the whole country. All the laws and regulations have been created by sages for thousands of years, but they are worthless. Why should we belittle ourselves and abandon the ones we have respected and followed for thousands of years as soon as we hear new theories? We are ashamed of ourselves and dare not speak to new people, or even cater to new people and slander the inheritance of our ancestors and insult our own theories. Are the laws and regulations issued by the country for hundreds of years and the ones we have been following for decades all false and worthless?" This view does not
A. show that the author's thoughts are stubborn and conservative
B. express dissatisfaction with the New Culture Movement
C. will be rejected by the mainstream culture at that time
D. reflect the self-confidence of national culture

Question: 洋务运动初期，军事工业生产的产品不经过市场流通而直接调拨各省。19世纪80年代后，沿海各省中哪一省需配备兵船就由该省筹款；江南制造总局和天津机器局等企业，如果所产某种武器的售价高于国际市场价格过多，就会停止生产。这说明洋务运动期间的军事工业
A: 逐渐由官办向官督商办转变
B: 使沿海军事力量布局平衡
C: 无法完全规避价值规律制约
D: 高度关注企业的生产成本

A. 逐渐由官办向官督商办转变
B. 使沿海军事力量布局平衡
C. 无法完全规避价值规律制约
D. 高度关注企业的生产成本

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early days of the Westernization Movement, the products produced by the military industry were directly allocated to the provinces without being circulated in the market. After the 1880s, the coastal provinces that needed to equip warships would raise funds; if the price of a certain weapon produced by the Jiangnan Manufacturing General Bureau and Tianjin Machinery Bureau was too much higher than the international market price, they would stop production. This shows that the military industry during the Westernization Movement
A. gradually changed from government-run to government-supervised and business-run
B. balanced the layout of coastal military forces
C. could not completely circumvent the constraints of the law of value
D. paid great attention to the production costs of enterprises

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Modern archaeology has unearthed many agricultural tools made of cast iron in the former sites of Qin, Wei and other countries. From 1950 to 1951, five large Wei tombs were excavated in Huixian, Henan. Tomb No. 1 unearthed 65 ironwares, of which 58 were agricultural tools, including a complete set of iron agricultural tools such as hoes, hoes, shovels, sickles, and plowshares. Material Description Warring States Period
A. Iron agricultural tools first appeared in Huixian, Henan
B. Casting of cast iron was determined by the Wei State
C. A complete set of iron agricultural tools is conducive to intensive farming
D. Iron agricultural tools have become a must-have burial item

Question: “中国为酷爱和平之民族，过去四年余之神圣抗战，原期侵略者之日本于遭受实际之惩创后，终能反省……不料残暴成性之日本，执迷不悟，且更悍然向我英美诸友邦开衅……兹特正式对日宣战”。这一告示发表的历史背景
A: 国共合作宣言公布
B: 太平洋战争爆发
C: 全面抗战开始
D: 九一八事变爆发

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
“中国为酷爱和平之民族，过去四年余之神圣抗战，原期侵略者之日本于遭受实际之惩创后，终能反省……不料残暴成性之日本，执迷不悟，且更悍然向我英美诸友邦开衅……兹特正式对日宣战”。这一告示发表的历史背景

en:
The next question is about China's history.
"China is a peace-loving nation. In the past four years of the sacred war of resistance, we hoped that the aggressor Japan would finally reflect after suffering actual punishment... Unexpectedly, the brutal Japan persisted in its delusion and even brazenly provoked our friendly countries such as Britain and the United States... We hereby formally declare war on Japan." The historical background of this notice
A. The announcement of the KMT-CPC cooperation declaration
B. The outbreak of the Pacific War
C. The start of the full-scale war of resistance
D. The outbreak of the September 18th Incident

A. is good in nature
B. is good in nature and is a habit
C. is evil in nature
D. is neither good nor evil

The next question is about China's history.

A. Adhering to the national revolutionary line
B. Abandoning the leadership of the proletariat over the revolution
C. Taking the national bourgeoisie as the target of the revolution
D. Implementing armed separatist regimes of workers and peasants

Question: 1903年，清政府颁布《铁路简明章程》规定：无论华洋官商，均可禀请开办铁路。如“华商请办铁路，集股以华股获占多数”，“附搭洋股，以不逾华股之数为限，洋商请办铁路，无论集股若干，总须留出股额十分之三，任华人随时照原价附股”。由此可知该章程
A: 利于救亡图存
B: 主张铁路国有
C: 不利民营铁路发展
D: 便利列强资本输出
options:
A. 利于救亡图存
B. 主张铁路国有
C. 不利民营铁路发展
D. 便利列强资本输出
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1903年，清政府颁布《铁路简明章程》规定：无论华洋官商，均可禀请开办铁路。如“华商请办铁路，集股以华股获占多数”，“附搭洋股，以不逾华股之数为限，洋商请办铁路，无论集股若干，总须留出股额十分之三，任华人随时照原价附股”。由此可知该章程
A. 利于救亡图存
B. 主张铁路国有
C. 不利民营铁路发展
D. 便利列强资本输出
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1903, the Qing government promulgated the "Simplified Railway Regulations", which stipulated that all Chinese and foreign officials and businessmen could apply to open railways. For example, "Chinese businessmen who apply to open railways must have a majority of Chinese shares" and "Foreign shares must not exceed the number of Chinese shares. Foreign businessmen who apply to open railways must reserve three-tenths of the shares regardless of the number of shares, and Chinese can attach shares at any time at the original price." From this, we can know that the regulations
A. are conducive to saving the nation from extinction
B. advocate nationalization of railways
C. are not conducive to the development of private railways
D. facilitate the export of capital from the great powers

B: 占据和控制台湾的国民党反动当局
C: 垄断核武器和空间技术的超级大国
D: 阻挠中国恢复联合国合法席位的势力
options:
A. 死灰复燃的日本军国主义势力
B. 占据和控制台湾的国民党反动当局
C. 垄断核武器和空间技术的超级大国
D. 阻挠中国恢复联合国合法席位的势力

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1958, at the enlarged meeting of the Military Commission, Mao Zedong said: "The atomic bomb is such a big thing. Without it, people will say you are not counting." General Zhang Aiping said: "No matter how poor we are, we must have a stick to beat the dog." The "people" and "dogs" in the text mainly refer to
A. The resurgent Japanese militarist forces
B. The reactionary Kuomintang authorities that occupy and control Taiwan

B: 民主政治建设法制化

zh:

en:
The next question is about China's history.

A: ac

options:

B. ab
C. cd

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The Tang Dynasty Six Code states: "The children of skilled craftsmen, once they become craftsmen, are not allowed to enter other professions"; the New Book of Tang states: "The craftsmanship of fine carving takes four years; the craftsmanship of carriages and musical instruments takes three years; the craftsmanship of flat knives and spears takes two years... The craftsmanship is passed down from generation to generation." This shows that craftsmen in the Tang Dynasty: a frequently changed their jobs; b worked in government workshops for a long time; c their professions were hereditary; d they were temporary workers

B. ab
C. cd
D. bc

Question: 《汉书·食货志》记载：“贾人有市籍，及家属，皆无得名田，以便农。敢犯令，没人田货。”该禁令的主要目的是
A: 保护小农经济
B: 加强商人户籍管理

D: 增加赋税收入

A. protect the small peasant economy

Question: 古代中西思想既有差异，也有相当接近的地方。如“注重人的全面发展、培养人的道德自觉”和“有益于人类、培养善人”的思想即属于后者。下列学派中接近上述思想的是：a儒家学派；b墨家学派；c斯多亚学派；d智者学派
A: bd
B: bcd
C: abc

A. bd
B. bcd

古代中西思想既有差异，也有相当接近的地方。如“注重人的全面发展、培养人的道德自觉”和“有益于人类、培养善人”的思想即属于后者。下列学派中接近上述思想的是：a儒家学派；b墨家学派；c斯多亚学派；d智者学派

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Ancient Chinese and Western thought have both differences and similarities. For example, the thought of "focusing on the all-round development of people and cultivating people's moral consciousness" and "benefiting mankind and cultivating good people" belong to the latter. The following schools are close to the above thoughts: a. Confucianism; b. Mohism; c. Stoicism; d. Sophists
A. bd
B. bcd
C. abc
D. ac

B: 新式教育与科举已融为一体

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1903, the Ta Kung Pao published an article saying: "Many new-school citizens and overseas students in Jiangnan cut off their braids, thinking that otherwise they would be inadequate in form. However, those who claim to be free and talk about civil rights are actually not as good as their ambition for fame." This shows that
A. The imperial examination system still has strong vitality
B. New-style education and the imperial examination have been integrated
C. Hairstyle has become a symbol to distinguish between new and old learning

Question: 清末民初政府在军队、警察、学生中推行西式礼服因制作西式礼服最适合的布料是进口呢绒，造成传统丝绸销量骤减，引发了商界的“提倡国货运动”。为此，民国政府规定西式礼服皆须用国产布帛。这说明
A: 传统与进步斗争激烈
B: 向西方学习应该符合国情
C: 经济因素阻碍了学习西方
D: 政府与民众矛盾重重
options:

清末民初政府在军队、警察、学生中推行西式礼服因制作西式礼服最适合的布料是进口呢绒，造成传统丝绸销量骤减，引发了商界的“提倡国货运动”。为此，民国政府规定西式礼服皆须用国产布帛。这说明

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, the government promoted Western-style formal wear among the army, police, and students. Since the most suitable fabric for making Western-style formal wear was imported woolen cloth, the sales of traditional silk plummeted, triggering the "Promoting Domestic Products Movement" in the business community. For this reason, the Republic of China government stipulated that Western-style formal wear must be made of domestically produced fabrics. This shows that
A. Tradition and progress are in fierce struggle
B. Learning from the West should be in line with national conditions
C. Economic factors hinder learning from the West
D. The government and the people are in conflict

Question: 在19世纪后半叶，棉纺织品始终列为中国进口商品中的重要项目。1874年至1894年20年间，洋布进口值增长88.4%。洋纱进口值增长将近986.7%。以上现象表明
A: 自然经济被彻底破坏
B: 中国棉纺织业取得较快发展

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the second half of the 19th century, cotton textiles were always listed as an important item in China's imports. In the 20 years from 1874 to 1894, the import value of foreign cloth increased by 88.4%. The import value of foreign yarn increased by nearly 986.7%. The above phenomenon shows that
A. The natural economy was completely destroyed
B. China's cotton textile industry has achieved rapid development
C. Foreign goods completely occupied the Chinese market
D. Traditional handicrafts still have the ability to resist

“世界潮流，浩浩荡荡，顺之则昌，逆之则亡。要跟上时代前进步伐，就不能身体已进入二十一世纪，而脑袋还停留在过去，停留在殖民扩张的旧时代里，停留在冷战思维、零和博弈的老框框内。”面对世界百年未有之大变局，中国在全球层面倡导

en:
The next question is about China's history.
"The world trend is mighty and powerful. If you follow it, you will prosper; if you go against it, you will perish. To keep up with the pace of the times, you cannot have entered the 21st century with your body but still have your mind in the past, in the old era of colonial expansion, in the old framework of Cold War thinking and zero-sum game." Faced with the great changes in the world that have not been seen for a century, China advocates at the global level
A. Establishment of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank
B. Establishment of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization
C. Building a community with a shared future for mankind

Question: 1916年1月，陈独秀在《青年杂志》撰文称：“个人之人格高，斯国家之人格亦高。个人之权巩固，斯国家之权亦巩固。而吾国自古相传之道德政治胥（皆）反乎是。”陈独秀意在
A: 主张国家至上

C: 传播马克思主义
D: 批判封建伦理
options:

C. 传播马克思主义

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1916年1月，陈独秀在《青年杂志》撰文称：“个人之人格高，斯国家之人格亦高。个人之权巩固，斯国家之权亦巩固。而吾国自古相传之道德政治胥（皆）反乎是。”陈独秀意在

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In January 1916, Chen Duxiu wrote in Youth Magazine: "When the character of an individual is high, the character of the country is also high. When the rights of an individual are consolidated, the rights of the country are also consolidated. However, the moral politics passed down from ancient times in our country are all contrary to this." Chen Duxiu intended to 
A. advocate the supremacy of the state 
B. oppose Western democracy 
C. spread Marxism 
D. criticize feudal ethics

A. was familiar with the Qin Dynasty's rules and regulations

A: 背离了原始儒学的民本思想

司马迁说：“居今之世，志古之道，所以自镜也，未必尽同。”下列选项中，与司马迁观点相符的是
A. 历史不会重演，不能以史为鉴
B. 历史可以重演，应当以史为鉴
C. 历史事实情同而势异，不能照搬历史经验
D. 一切历史都是当代史，无须学习古人
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Sima Qian said: "Living in the present world, we aspire to the ways of the past, so we can mirror ourselves, but we may not always agree with them." Which of the following options is consistent with Sima Qian's view?
A. History will not repeat itself, so we cannot learn from history
B. History can repeat itself, so we should learn from history
C. Historical facts are the same but the situation is different, so we cannot copy historical experience
D. All history is contemporary history, so there is no need to learn from the ancients

Question: 顾炎武《日知录》中写道：“心不待传也，流行天地间，贯彻古今而不同者理也，理具于吾心而验于物。心者，所以统宗此理而别其是非，心学二字，《六经》、孔孟所不道。”这一观点表明他
A: 以拯救时代为己任
B: 对陆王心学持批判的态度
C: 主张回归孔孟儒学
D: 肯定心学的修身养性功能
options:
A. 以拯救时代为己任
B. 对陆王心学持批判的态度
C. 主张回归孔孟儒学
D. 肯定心学的修身养性功能

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
顾炎武《日知录》中写道：“心不待传也，流行天地间，贯彻古今而不同者理也，理具于吾心而验于物。心者，所以统宗此理而别其是非，心学二字，《六经》、孔孟所不道。”这一观点表明他

C. 主张回归孔孟儒学

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Gu Yanwu wrote in "Rizhilu": "The mind does not need to be passed on. It is prevalent in the world. What runs through the past and present is reason. Reason is in our mind and can be verified in things. The mind is used to unify this reason and distinguish right from wrong. The word "mind learning" is not mentioned in the "Six Classics" and Confucius and Mencius." This view shows that he
A. took it as his responsibility to save the times
B. held a critical attitude towards Lu and Wang's mind learning
C. advocated returning to Confucianism of Confucius and Mencius
D. affirmed the function of mind learning in self-cultivation

Question: 司马迁的《史记》记载了商王的世系，但长期以来并不能确定该记载是否真实。19世纪末20世纪初殷墟甲骨文的发现，证实《史记》的记载基本上是正确的。这说明
A: 历史记载必须经过考古发现证实
B: 考古发现是历史研究的重要依据
C: 考古资料比文献材料更真实
D: 历史记载不存在纯粹客观性
options:
A. 历史记载必须经过考古发现证实
B. 考古发现是历史研究的重要依据
C. 考古资料比文献材料更真实
D. 历史记载不存在纯粹客观性

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Sima Qian's "Records of the Grand Historian" records the lineage of the Shang kings, but for a long time it was not certain whether the record was true. The discovery of oracle bones in Yinxu in the late 19th and early 20th centuries confirmed that the record in "Records of the Grand Historian" was basically correct. This shows that
A. Historical records must be confirmed by archaeological discoveries
B. Archaeological discoveries are an important basis for historical research
C. Archaeological data are more authentic than documentary materials
D. Historical records do not exist in pure objectivity

Question: 西汉初年的各种制度基本沿袭秦朝，但施政方针有了诸多重大调整。下列各项，属于西汉初年施政方针“”的是
A: 采取“与民休息”政策
B: 颁布推恩令削弱王侯势力
C: 实施尊崇儒术的文化改革

en:
The next question is about China's history.
The various systems in the early Western Han Dynasty basically followed those of the Qin Dynasty, but the policies were adjusted in many ways. The following items belong to the policies of the early Western Han Dynasty
A. Adopting the policy of "resting with the people"
B. Issuing the Enfeoffment Order to weaken the power of the princes
C. Implementing cultural reforms that respect Confucianism
D. Establishing the Central Dynasty directly controlled by the emperor

Question: 唐末五代，中央集权大为削弱。为扭转这一局面，宋初采取的重要措施之一是
A: 设枢密院
B: 设三司使
C: 文官任知州
D: 施行将兵法
options:

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the late Tang Dynasty and the Five Dynasties, the central power was greatly weakened. In order to reverse this situation, one of the important measures taken in the early Song Dynasty was
A. Establishing the Privy Council
B. Establishing the Three Commissioners
C. Civil officials serving as prefects
D. Implementing the Military Strategy

Question: 天津著名中药企业达仁堂如今已有百年历史。20世纪50年代纳入国家集中统一管理后，原有分号与其全部脱钩，达仁堂只管生产，不管销售。在20 世纪90 年代中期的发展中，该企业曾一度“拔剑四顾心茫然”。造成其“茫然”的主要原因是
A: 企业尚未适应市场经
B: 企业失去分号，力量削弱
C: 企业产品质量下滑
D: 集中统一管理使企业失去活力
options:
A. 企业尚未适应市场经
B. 企业失去分号，力量削弱
C. 企业产品质量下滑
D. 集中统一管理使企业失去活力
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
天津著名中药企业达仁堂如今已有百年历史。20世纪50年代纳入国家集中统一管理后，原有分号与其全部脱钩，达仁堂只管生产，不管销售。在20 世纪90 年代中期的发展中，该企业曾一度“拔剑四顾心茫然”。造成其“茫然”的主要原因是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Darentang, a famous traditional Chinese medicine enterprise in Tianjin, now has a history of 100 years. After being included in the centralized and unified management of the state in the 1950s, the original branch was completely decoupled from it, and Darentang only cared about production, not sales. During its development in the mid-1990s, the company once "drew its sword and looked around with a confused heart". The main reasons for its "confusion" are 
A. The company has not yet adapted to the market economy
B. The company lost its branch and its strength was weakened
C. The quality of the company's products declined
D. The centralized and unified management made the company lose its vitality

Question: 1980年与1975年想不，我国粮食播种面积减少6.884万亩，总产量却增加674亿斤；面糊哈播种面积减少53万亩，总产量却增加652万担；油料作物和天草播种面积共扩大3 626万亩，其总产量分别增加70%和150%。出现这一现象的主要原因是
A: 农村经济体制改革完成
B: 农民生产自主权扩大
C: 国家取消对农副产品的统销政策
D: 农业生产技术有了革命性的改变
options:
A. 农村经济体制改革完成
B. 农民生产自主权扩大
C. 国家取消对农副产品的统销政策
D. 农业生产技术有了革命性的改变
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1980年与1975年想不，我国粮食播种面积减少6.884万亩，总产量却增加674亿斤；面糊哈播种面积减少53万亩，总产量却增加652万担；油料作物和天草播种面积共扩大3 626万亩，其总产量分别增加70%和150%。出现这一现象的主要原因是
A. 农村经济体制改革完成
B. 农民生产自主权扩大
C. 国家取消对农副产品的统销政策

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1980, compared with 1975, my country's grain planting area decreased by 68,840 mu, but the total output increased by 67.4 billion jin; the flour planting area decreased by 530,000 mu, but the total output increased by 6.52 million dan; the planting area of oil crops and grass increased by 36.26 million mu, and their total output increased by 70% and 150% respectively. The main reasons for this phenomenon are 
A. The completion of the rural economic system reform 
B. The expansion of farmers' production autonomy 
C. The state abolished the policy of unified marketing of agricultural and sideline products 
D. Agricultural production technology has undergone revolutionary changes

Question: 学者陈旭麓认为：“近代中国社会的新陈代谢突出地表现为两个方面，一是新的取代旧的，如民国取代清朝；一是新与新的递嬗，前一种新的褪色了，后一种新的跟上来，辛亥之与戊戌是这样，‘五四’之与辛亥是这样，戊戌之与洋务也有这种迹象。”推动这种“新陈代谢”的核心动力是
A: 挽救民族危亡
B: 推动实业救国
C: 提倡民主科学
D: 发展资本主义
options:
A. 挽救民族危亡
B. 推动实业救国
C. 提倡民主科学
D. 发展资本主义
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
学者陈旭麓认为：“近代中国社会的新陈代谢突出地表现为两个方面，一是新的取代旧的，如民国取代清朝；一是新与新的递嬗，前一种新的褪色了，后一种新的跟上来，辛亥之与戊戌是这样，‘五四’之与辛亥是这样，戊戌之与洋务也有这种迹象。”推动这种“新陈代谢”的核心动力是
A. 挽救民族危亡
B. 推动实业救国
C. 提倡民主科学
D. 发展资本主义
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Scholar Chen Xulu believes that: "The metabolism of modern Chinese society is prominently manifested in two aspects: one is the replacement of the old by the new, such as the replacement of the Qing Dynasty by the Republic of China; the other is the succession of the new and the new, the former fades, and the latter catches up. This is the case between the Xinhai Revolution and the Wuxu Movement, the May Fourth Movement and the Xinhai Revolution, and the Wuxu Movement and the Westernization Movement." The core driving force behind this "metabolism" is 
A. Saving the nation from danger
B. Promoting industry to save the country
C. Promoting democracy and science
D. Developing capitalism

Question: 明末清初，王夫之主张“有其力者治其地”，黄宗羲提出“授民以田”“田土均之”，顾炎武力主“均田”，这些主张
A: 目的是维护清朝统治
B: 表达了对个体小农的关注
C: 体现了重农抑商思想
D: 具有浓厚的复古色彩
options:

B. 表达了对个体小农的关注
C. 体现了重农抑商思想
D. 具有浓厚的复古色彩
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
明末清初，王夫之主张“有其力者治其地”，黄宗羲提出“授民以田”“田土均之”，顾炎武力主“均田”，这些主张

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, Wang Fuzhi advocated "those who have the power should rule their land", Huang Zongxi proposed "granting the people land" and "equal distribution of land", and Gu Yanwu advocated "equal distribution of land". These proposals
A. The purpose is to maintain the rule of the Qing Dynasty
B. Expressed concern for individual small farmers
C. Reflected the idea of emphasizing agriculture and suppressing commerce
D. Has a strong retro color

Question: 宋代，有田产的“主户”只占民户总数20%左右，其余大都是四处租种土地的“客户”，导致这种状况的重要因素是
A: 政府管理失控
B: 土地政策调整
C: 坊市制度崩溃
D: 经济严重衰退
options:
A. 政府管理失控
B. 土地政策调整
C. 坊市制度崩溃

宋代，有田产的“主户”只占民户总数20%左右，其余大都是四处租种土地的“客户”，导致这种状况的重要因素是

en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the Song Dynasty, only about 20% of the households had land, and the rest were mostly "customers" who rented land for farming. The main factors leading to this situation were: 
A. Government management out of control
B. Land policy adjustment
C. Collapse of the market system
D. Severe economic recession

Question: 明朝时“田中事，田主一切不问，皆佃农任之”，地主与佃农之间，“交租之外，两不相问”。此种现象反映出当时
A: 土地所有权与经营权没有分离
B: 租佃制抑制了佃农的生产积极性
C: 地主与佃农间存在雇佣关系
D: 佃农有较大的生产自主权
options:
A. 土地所有权与经营权没有分离
B. 租佃制抑制了佃农的生产积极性
C. 地主与佃农间存在雇佣关系
D. 佃农有较大的生产自主权
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
明朝时“田中事，田主一切不问，皆佃农任之”，地主与佃农之间，“交租之外，两不相问”。此种现象反映出当时

en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the Ming Dynasty, "the landlord did not care about anything in the fields, and the tenants were responsible for it." Between the landlord and the tenant, "except for paying rent, the two did not ask each other." This phenomenon reflects that at that time
A. Land ownership and management rights were not separated
B. The tenancy system suppressed the production enthusiasm of the tenants
C. There was an employment relationship between the landlord and the tenant
D. The tenants had greater production autonomy

Question: 徐州古丰县，有村曰朱陈。去县百余里，桑麻青氛氲。机梭声札札，牛驴走纭纭。女汲涧中水，男采山上薪。县远官事少，山深人俗淳。有财不行商，有丁不入军。家家守村业，头白不出门。生为村之民，死为村之尘。”(白居易《朱陈村》)由此可以得出的结论是
A: 小农经济不利于古代中央集权和商品经济发展
B: 唐代开始出现个体小农经济
C: 男耕女织、自给自足是古代农业经济的特点之一
D: 精耕细作是古代农业经济的特点之一
options:
A. 小农经济不利于古代中央集权和商品经济发展
B. 唐代开始出现个体小农经济
C. 男耕女织、自给自足是古代农业经济的特点之一
D. 精耕细作是古代农业经济的特点之一
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
徐州古丰县，有村曰朱陈。去县百余里，桑麻青氛氲。机梭声札札，牛驴走纭纭。女汲涧中水，男采山上薪。县远官事少，山深人俗淳。有财不行商，有丁不入军。家家守村业，头白不出门。生为村之民，死为村之尘。”(白居易《朱陈村》)由此可以得出的结论是
A. 小农经济不利于古代中央集权和商品经济发展
B. 唐代开始出现个体小农经济
C. 男耕女织、自给自足是古代农业经济的特点之一
D. 精耕细作是古代农业经济的特点之一
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In Gufeng County, Xuzhou, there is a village called Zhuchen. More than a hundred miles away from the county, mulberry and hemp are green and dense. The sound of looms and shuttles is heard, and cows and donkeys are running. Women draw water from the stream, and men collect firewood from the mountains. The county is far away and there are few official affairs. The mountains are deep and the people are simple. People with money do not do business, and people with money do not join the army. Every family guards the village business and does not go out until they are old. Live as a villager and die as dust of the village. "(Bai Juyi's "Zhuchen Village") The conclusion that can be drawn from this is
A. Small peasant economy is not conducive to the development of ancient centralization and commodity economy
B. Individual small peasant economy began to appear in the Tang Dynasty
C. Men farm and women weave, and self-sufficiency is one of the characteristics of ancient agricultural economy
D. Intensive farming is one of the characteristics of ancient agricultural economy

Question: 1950年6月，朝鲜战争爆发。中国战士高唱“雄纠纠，气昂昂，跨过鸭绿江。保和平，卫祖国，就是保家乡……”入朝参战。入朝部队的称呼是
A: 中国人民解放军
B: 国民革命军第八路军
C: 中国人民志愿军
D: 东北野战军
options:
A. 中国人民解放军
B. 国民革命军第八路军
C. 中国人民志愿军
D. 东北野战军
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1950年6月，朝鲜战争爆发。中国战士高唱“雄纠纠，气昂昂，跨过鸭绿江。保和平，卫祖国，就是保家乡……”入朝参战。入朝部队的称呼是
A. 中国人民解放军
B. 国民革命军第八路军
C. 中国人民志愿军
D. 东北野战军
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In June 1950, the Korean War broke out. Chinese soldiers sang "We are strong and vigorous, crossing the Yalu River. To protect peace, to defend the motherland, is to protect our hometown..." and entered Korea to participate in the war. The name of the troops entering Korea was
A. Chinese People's Liberation Army
B. The Eighth Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army
C. Chinese People's Volunteer Army
D. Northeast Field Army

Question: 殷商甲骨卜辞：“癸卯卜，今日雨。其自西来雨?其自东来雨?其自北来雨?其自南来雨?”对此理解不正确的是
A: 卜辞反映出古代生产力低下
B: 卜辞中文字与现代汉字非常接近
C: 说明古代人们对自然的依赖性强
D: 卜辞可被视为原始形态的农事诗
options:
A. 卜辞反映出古代生产力低下
B. 卜辞中文字与现代汉字非常接近
C. 说明古代人们对自然的依赖性强
D. 卜辞可被视为原始形态的农事诗
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
殷商甲骨卜辞：“癸卯卜，今日雨。其自西来雨?其自东来雨?其自北来雨?其自南来雨?”对此理解不正确的是
A. 卜辞反映出古代生产力低下
B. 卜辞中文字与现代汉字非常接近
C. 说明古代人们对自然的依赖性强
D. 卜辞可被视为原始形态的农事诗
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Oracle bone inscriptions from the Shang Dynasty: "Gui Mao divination, today is raining. Will it rain from the west? Will it rain from the east? Will it rain from the north? Will it rain from the south?" The incorrect understanding of this is
A. Oracle inscriptions reflect the low productivity in ancient times
B. The characters in the oracle inscriptions are very similar to modern Chinese characters
C. It shows that ancient people relied heavily on nature
D. Oracle inscriptions can be regarded as a primitive form of agricultural poetry

Question: 唐诗“慢束罗裙半露胸”、“绮罗纤缕见肌肤”，描写了唐朝服饰的艳丽奢华和开放。但宋朝时的服饰却简洁质朴，女装拘谨、保守，色彩淡雅恬静。唐宋服饰的演变，反映了人们审美观的变化，此种审美观的转变主要是由于
A: 封建经济的衰退
B: 审美意识的觉醒
C: 程朱理学思想的影响
D: 专制集权的巩固
options:
A. 封建经济的衰退
B. 审美意识的觉醒
C. 程朱理学思想的影响
D. 专制集权的巩固

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
唐诗“慢束罗裙半露胸”、“绮罗纤缕见肌肤”，描写了唐朝服饰的艳丽奢华和开放。但宋朝时的服饰却简洁质朴，女装拘谨、保守，色彩淡雅恬静。唐宋服饰的演变，反映了人们审美观的变化，此种审美观的转变主要是由于

B. 审美意识的觉醒
C. 程朱理学思想的影响

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Tang Dynasty poems such as "slowly tied silk skirt half exposed chest" and "fine silk reveals skin" describe the gorgeous luxury and openness of Tang Dynasty clothing. However, the clothing in the Song Dynasty was simple and plain, women's clothing was restrained and conservative, and the colors were elegant and quiet. The evolution of Tang and Song clothing reflects the change of people's aesthetics. This change in aesthetics is mainly due to
A. The decline of feudal economy
B. The awakening of aesthetic consciousness
C. The influence of Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism
D. The consolidation of autocracy

Question: 北魏时，贾思勰的《齐民耍术》总结出一套个体农户农副兼营的精耕细作农业模式，反复强调农户不要过度扩大耕种面积，“宁可少好，不可多恶”。这表明
A: 精耕细作农业遏止了大土地所有制的发展
B: 人口与土地的尖锐矛盾导致耕作模式的转变
C: 精耕细作的目的是追求农业收益的最大化
D: 十体农户为主体的耕作模式抻制农业的进步
options:
A. 精耕细作农业遏止了大土地所有制的发展
B. 人口与土地的尖锐矛盾导致耕作模式的转变
C. 精耕细作的目的是追求农业收益的最大化
D. 十体农户为主体的耕作模式抻制农业的进步

A. 精耕细作农业遏止了大土地所有制的发展
B. 人口与土地的尖锐矛盾导致耕作模式的转变
C. 精耕细作的目的是追求农业收益的最大化
D. 十体农户为主体的耕作模式抻制农业的进步
en:
The next question is about China's history.
During the Northern Wei Dynasty, Jia Sixie's "Qimin Shuoshu" summarized a set of intensive farming models in which individual farmers engaged in both farming and sideline production, and repeatedly emphasized that farmers should not over-expand the cultivated area, "it is better to have less good than more bad". This shows that 
A. Intensive farming curbed the development of large land ownership 
B. The sharp contradiction between population and land led to the transformation of farming patterns 
C. The purpose of intensive farming is to maximize agricultural benefits 
D. The farming model with individual farmers as the main body has restricted the progress of agriculture

Question: 中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议召开前，周恩来等中共领导人要求接送在港民主人士，进入解放区，参加筹备新政协。据统计，从 1948 年 8 月到 1949 年 8 月，共安排秘密北上的民主人士 20 批，其中有 119 人参加了政协会议。 中共的这一举动主要是为了
A: 贯彻“长期共存，互相监督冶方针
B: 协商制定第一个五年计划
C: 恢复民主党派的各级组织
D: 团结民主人士共同筹建新中国
options:
A. 贯彻“长期共存，互相监督冶方针
B. 协商制定第一个五年计划
C. 恢复民主党派的各级组织
D. 团结民主人士共同筹建新中国

en:
The next question is about China's history.
Before the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Zhou Enlai and other CCP leaders requested to pick up democratic figures in Hong Kong and bring them to the liberated areas to participate in the preparations for the new CPPCC. According to statistics, from August 1948 to August 1949, a total of 20 groups of democratic figures were arranged to secretly go north, of which 119 participated in the CPPCC meeting. The main purpose of this move by the CCP was to
A. implement the policy of "long-term coexistence and mutual supervision"
B. negotiate and formulate the first five-year plan
C. restore the organizations of democratic parties at all levels
D. unite democratic figures to jointly prepare for the establishment of a new China

Question: 有学者认为，宋代到清代的历史进程中有过三次商业革命，第一次是宋代商业革命，第二次是明清(前期)商业革命。其中第二次“商业革命”比第一次突出的是
A: 南方工商业市镇的兴盛
B: 商业活动突破时空限制
C: 出现了世界最早的纸币
D: 民间对外贸易空前活跃
options:
A. 南方工商业市镇的兴盛
B. 商业活动突破时空限制
C. 出现了世界最早的纸币
D. 民间对外贸易空前活跃
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
有学者认为，宋代到清代的历史进程中有过三次商业革命，第一次是宋代商业革命，第二次是明清(前期)商业革命。其中第二次“商业革命”比第一次突出的是
A. 南方工商业市镇的兴盛
B. 商业活动突破时空限制
C. 出现了世界最早的纸币
D. 民间对外贸易空前活跃
en:
The next question is about China's history.
Some scholars believe that there were three commercial revolutions in the historical process from the Song Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. The first was the Song Dynasty Commercial Revolution, and the second was the Ming and Qing Dynasty (early period) Commercial Revolution. The second "commercial revolution" was more prominent than the first one in that
A. The prosperity of industrial and commercial towns in the south
B. Commercial activities broke through the limitations of time and space
C. The world's earliest paper money appeared
D. Private foreign trade was unprecedentedly active

Question: 中国古代的一部作品，以神游天地、上下求索的幻想境界表达了作者对理想的执着追求，大量运用“美人芳草”的比兴手法和瑰丽的语言，闪耀着南方楚文化的奇丽色彩。该作品是
A: 《老子》
B: 《诗经》
C: 《庄子》
D: 《离骚》
options:
A. 《老子》
B. 《诗经》
C. 《庄子》
D. 《离骚》

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
中国古代的一部作品，以神游天地、上下求索的幻想境界表达了作者对理想的执着追求，大量运用“美人芳草”的比兴手法和瑰丽的语言，闪耀着南方楚文化的奇丽色彩。该作品是
A. 《老子》

en:
The next question is about China's history.
A work from ancient China, which expresses the author's persistent pursuit of ideals through the fantasy realm of wandering in the heavens and earth and seeking truth from facts. It makes extensive use of the metaphorical techniques of "beautiful women and fragrant grasses" and magnificent language, shining with the wonderful colors of southern Chu culture. The work is
A. "Laozi"
B. "The Book of Songs"
C. "Zhuangzi"
D. "Li Sao"

Question: 《中华人民共和国史>在解释“打扫干净屋子再请客”时引述了毛泽东的一段话：“关于帝国主义对我国的承认问题，不但现在不应急于去解决，就是在全国胜利以后的一个相当长时期内，也不应急于去解决。因为虽然我们愿意按照平等原则同一切国家建立外交关系，但帝国主义是绝不能很快地就以平等态度对待我们的。”上述材料体现了新中国
A: 不承认国民政府建立的旧外交
B: 坚定地站在社会主义阵营一边
C: 取缔列强在华特权的强烈愿望
D: 坚决保障社会主义革命的胜利成果
options:
A. 不承认国民政府建立的旧外交
B. 坚定地站在社会主义阵营一边
C. 取缔列强在华特权的强烈愿望
D. 坚决保障社会主义革命的胜利成果
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
《中华人民共和国史>在解释“打扫干净屋子再请客”时引述了毛泽东的一段话：“关于帝国主义对我国的承认问题，不但现在不应急于去解决，就是在全国胜利以后的一个相当长时期内，也不应急于去解决。因为虽然我们愿意按照平等原则同一切国家建立外交关系，但帝国主义是绝不能很快地就以平等态度对待我们的。”上述材料体现了新中国

D. 坚决保障社会主义革命的胜利成果
en:
The next question is about China's history.
The History of the People's Republic of China quoted a passage from Mao Zedong when explaining "clean up the house before inviting guests": "Regarding the issue of imperialism's recognition of our country, we should not rush to solve it not only now, but also for a considerable period after the national victory. Because although we are willing to establish diplomatic relations with all countries on the principle of equality, imperialism will never treat us equally so quickly." The above materials reflect that New China
A. does not recognize the old diplomacy established by the National Government
B. stands firmly on the side of the socialist camp
C. has a strong desire to abolish the privileges of the great powers in China
D. resolutely safeguards the victory of the socialist revolution

Question: 20世纪50年代，中苏两国对中国的某一新生事物产生了不同看法。前者认为它是“中国加速社会主义建设，向共产主义过渡的最好形式”；后者则认为20—30年代的苏联类似尝试，但“在经济上是不合理的”。“它”是指
A: 土地改革
B: “一五”计划
C: 人民公社
D: 社会主义三大改造
options:
A. 土地改革
B. “一五”计划
C. 人民公社
D. 社会主义三大改造
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
20世纪50年代，中苏两国对中国的某一新生事物产生了不同看法。前者认为它是“中国加速社会主义建设，向共产主义过渡的最好形式”；后者则认为20—30年代的苏联类似尝试，但“在经济上是不合理的”。“它”是指
A. 土地改革
B. “一五”计划
C. 人民公社
D. 社会主义三大改造
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the 1950s, China and the Soviet Union had different views on a new thing in China. The former believed that it was "the best form for China to accelerate socialist construction and transition to communism"; the latter believed that the Soviet Union had similar attempts in the 1920s and 1930s, but they were "economically unreasonable." "It" refers to
A. Land reform
B. "First Five-Year Plan"
C. People's Commune
D. Three major socialist reforms

Question: 北宋中期，“蜀民以铁钱重，私为券，谓之交子，以便贸易，富民十六户主之。其后，富者资稍衰，不能偿所负，争讼数起”。这表明交子
A: 具有民间交易凭证功能
B: 产生于民间的商业纠纷
C: 促进了经济重心的南移
D: 提高了富商的社会地位
options:
A. 具有民间交易凭证功能
B. 产生于民间的商业纠纷
C. 促进了经济重心的南移
D. 提高了富商的社会地位
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
北宋中期，“蜀民以铁钱重，私为券，谓之交子，以便贸易，富民十六户主之。其后，富者资稍衰，不能偿所负，争讼数起”。这表明交子
A. 具有民间交易凭证功能
B. 产生于民间的商业纠纷
C. 促进了经济重心的南移
D. 提高了富商的社会地位
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the middle of the Northern Song Dynasty, "the people of Shu used the weight of iron coins to make private vouchers, called Jiaozi, to facilitate trade. Sixteen wealthy households owned them. Later, the rich people's assets declined and they could not repay their debts, so several disputes arose." This shows that Jiaozi
A. It has the function of a voucher for private transactions
B. It arises from commercial disputes among the people
C. It promotes the southward shift of the economic center
D. It improves the social status of wealthy merchants

Question: 19世纪60年代，江浙地区出现了“蚕事乍毕丝事起，乡农卖丝争赴市……番舶来银百万计，中国商人皆若狂……遂使家家置纺车，无复有心种菽粟”的现象。它反映出
A: 资本输出成为列强侵华的主要手段
B: 开埠通商促进了江浙地区民族工业的发展
C: 中国对外贸易由入超变为出超
D: 市场扩大刺激了江浙地区丝织业发展
options:
A. 资本输出成为列强侵华的主要手段
B. 开埠通商促进了江浙地区民族工业的发展
C. 中国对外贸易由入超变为出超
D. 市场扩大刺激了江浙地区丝织业发展
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
19世纪60年代，江浙地区出现了“蚕事乍毕丝事起，乡农卖丝争赴市……番舶来银百万计，中国商人皆若狂……遂使家家置纺车，无复有心种菽粟”的现象。它反映出

D. 市场扩大刺激了江浙地区丝织业发展
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the 1860s, the Jiangsu and Zhejiang regions saw the phenomenon of "silkworm business was over and silk business started, rural farmers rushed to the market to sell silk... foreign merchants were crazy about the millions of silver... every family bought a spinning wheel and no longer had the heart to grow beans and millet." It reflects
A. Capital export became the main means of invasion of China by the great powers
B. Opening ports for trade promoted the development of national industries in Jiangsu and Zhejiang
C. China's foreign trade changed from a surplus to a surplus
D. Market expansion stimulated the development of silk weaving industry in Jiangsu and Zhejiang

Question: 1950年，东北人民政府规定在大区范围内对煤炭、钢材等多种生产资料统一分配，随后，东北地区计划分配的物资种类逐年增加。从1953年起，计划分配调拨体制开始在全国铺开。这反映了中国计划经济体制
A: 是在宪法原则下建立的
B: 是新生国家政权的基础
C: 随着工业化建设的进行而建立
D: 随着行政区域的扩大逐步建立
options:
A. 是在宪法原则下建立的
B. 是新生国家政权的基础
C. 随着工业化建设的进行而建立
D. 随着行政区域的扩大逐步建立
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1950年，东北人民政府规定在大区范围内对煤炭、钢材等多种生产资料统一分配，随后，东北地区计划分配的物资种类逐年增加。从1953年起，计划分配调拨体制开始在全国铺开。这反映了中国计划经济体制
A. 是在宪法原则下建立的
B. 是新生国家政权的基础
C. 随着工业化建设的进行而建立
D. 随着行政区域的扩大逐步建立
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1950, the Northeast People's Government stipulated that coal, steel and other means of production should be uniformly distributed in the region. Subsequently, the types of materials planned for distribution in the Northeast increased year by year. From 1953, the planned distribution and allocation system began to be rolled out across the country. This reflects that China's planned economic system
A. was established under the principles of the Constitution
B. is the foundation of the new national regime
C. was established with the progress of industrialization construction
D. was gradually established with the expansion of administrative areas

Question: 1915~1918年，《新青年》中“革命”“科学”“平等”“民主”等词出现频次大体相当；1919~1922年，“民主”出现次数不到“科学”的1/10，不及“革命”的1/20。这种变化可说明
A: 国民革命运动受到民众普遍拥护
B: 资本主义政体模式被知识界否定
C: 新文化运动主流思想发生转变
D: 中国社会主要矛盾发生改变
options:
A. 国民革命运动受到民众普遍拥护
B. 资本主义政体模式被知识界否定
C. 新文化运动主流思想发生转变
D. 中国社会主要矛盾发生改变
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1915~1918年，《新青年》中“革命”“科学”“平等”“民主”等词出现频次大体相当；1919~1922年，“民主”出现次数不到“科学”的1/10，不及“革命”的1/20。这种变化可说明

D. 中国社会主要矛盾发生改变
en:
The next question is about China's history.
From 1915 to 1918, the frequency of appearance of words such as "revolution", "science", "equality" and "democracy" in "New Youth" was roughly the same; from 1919 to 1922, the frequency of "democracy" was less than 1/10 of "science" and less than 1/20 of "revolution". This change can explain
A. The national revolutionary movement was widely supported by the people
B. The capitalist political system model was denied by the intellectual community
C. The mainstream thought of the New Culture Movement changed
D. The main contradictions in Chinese society changed

Question: 东汉初年桓谭上书说：“（重本抑末）此所以抑并兼、长廉耻也。今富商大贾，多放钱货……收税与封君比入。”据此推论合理的是
A: 东汉初年金融业繁荣，资本主义萌芽出现
B: 东汉初年商人经济实力强，桓谭建议厉行重农抑商
C: 东汉初年商人与封君勾结，中央集权削弱
D: 重农抑商是中国古代基本政策，桓谭描述的现象不存在
options:
A. 东汉初年金融业繁荣，资本主义萌芽出现
B. 东汉初年商人经济实力强，桓谭建议厉行重农抑商
C. 东汉初年商人与封君勾结，中央集权削弱
D. 重农抑商是中国古代基本政策，桓谭描述的现象不存在
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
东汉初年桓谭上书说：“（重本抑末）此所以抑并兼、长廉耻也。今富商大贾，多放钱货……收税与封君比入。”据此推论合理的是
A. 东汉初年金融业繁荣，资本主义萌芽出现
B. 东汉初年商人经济实力强，桓谭建议厉行重农抑商
C. 东汉初年商人与封君勾结，中央集权削弱
D. 重农抑商是中国古代基本政策，桓谭描述的现象不存在
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In the early Eastern Han Dynasty, Huan Tan wrote in a letter: "(Focus on the basics and suppress the details) This is to suppress annexation and promote integrity. Today, wealthy merchants put out a lot of money and goods... and collect taxes comparable to those of feudal lords." Based on this, the reasonable inference is
A. The financial industry flourished in the early Eastern Han Dynasty, and the sprouts of capitalism appeared
B. In the early Eastern Han Dynasty, merchants had strong economic strength, and Huan Tan suggested that they should strictly focus on agriculture and suppress commerce
C. In the early Eastern Han Dynasty, merchants colluded with feudal lords, and central power was weakened
D. Focusing on agriculture and suppressing commerce was the basic policy of ancient China, and the phenomenon described by Huan Tan did not exist

Question: “代替那存在着阶级和阶级对立的资产阶级旧社会的，将是这样一个联合体，在那里，每个人的自由发展是一切人的自由发展的条件。”这段话出自
A: 《共产党宣言》
B: 《政府论》
C: 《乌托邦》
D: 《共同纲领》
options:
A. 《共产党宣言》
B. 《政府论》

zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
“代替那存在着阶级和阶级对立的资产阶级旧社会的，将是这样一个联合体，在那里，每个人的自由发展是一切人的自由发展的条件。”这段话出自
A. 《共产党宣言》
B. 《政府论》
C. 《乌托邦》
D. 《共同纲领》
en:
The next question is about China's history.
"The old bourgeois society, with its classes and class antagonisms, will be replaced by an association in which the free development of each is the condition for the free development of all." This passage is from
A. The Communist Manifesto
B. The Theory of Government
C. Utopia
D. The Common Program

Question: 1923年，陈独秀说：“五四运动虽然未能达到理想的成功，而在此运动中最努力的革命青年，逐接受世界的革命思潮，由空想而实际运动，开始了中国革命之新的方向。”陈独秀所说的“中国革命之新的方向”指
A: 无产阶级革命
B: 国民革命
C: 民族革命
D: 武装革命
options:
A. 无产阶级革命
B. 国民革命
C. 民族革命
D. 武装革命
zh:
下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
1923年，陈独秀说：“五四运动虽然未能达到理想的成功，而在此运动中最努力的革命青年，逐接受世界的革命思潮，由空想而实际运动，开始了中国革命之新的方向。”陈独秀所说的“中国革命之新的方向”指
A. 无产阶级革命
B. 国民革命
C. 民族革命
D. 武装革命
en:
The next question is about China's history.
In 1923, Chen Duxiu said: "Although the May Fourth Movement failed to achieve its ideal success, the most hardworking revolutionary youth in this movement gradually accepted the world's revolutionary thoughts, and from fantasy to practical movement, began a new direction for the Chinese revolution." The "new direction of the Chinese revolution" mentioned by Chen Duxiu refers to
A. Proletarian Revolution
B. National Revolution
C. National Revolution
D. Armed Revolution

Question: “宋沿唐制，亦贵进士科。然唐时犹兼采誉望，不专辞章。宋则糊名考校，一决文字而已。”由此可见，与唐代科举相比，宋代
A: 取士科目有所减少
B: 考试程序更加公正
C: 进士及第尤为尊贵
D: 录取人数大大增加

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
“宋沿唐制，亦贵进士科。然唐时犹兼采誉望，不专辞章。宋则糊名考校，一决文字而已。”由此可见，与唐代科举相比，宋代
A. 取士科目有所减少

en:
The next question is about China's history.
"The Song Dynasty followed the Tang Dynasty system and also valued the Jinshi examination. However, in the Tang Dynasty, reputation was also considered, not just the writing. In the Song Dynasty, the candidates were tested anonymously and only the writing was decided." It can be seen that compared with the Tang Dynasty, the Song Dynasty
A. The number of subjects for selecting candidates was reduced
B. The examination process was more fair
C. The Jinshi was particularly prestigious
D. The number of admissions increased greatly

Question: 下列表述，与洋务派创办军事工业的初衷最为吻合的是
A: “外争国权，内除国贼”
B: “可以剿发逆，可以勤远略”
C: “师夷之长技以制夷”
D: “驱除鞑虏，恢复中华”
options:

下一个问题是关于中国的历史。
下列表述，与洋务派创办军事工业的初衷最为吻合的是
